subject: Week 14: Legislative Update
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=e6f29c0464&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

My recap for the week at the Capitol might be a bit shorter than previous weeks. As I mentioned in last week’s legislative update, this week I would provide some insights into some education bills that were introduced this legislative session in lieu of a day-by-day digest of bill tracking since we aren’t meeting daily since committee work has wrapped up. The legislature moved to meeting once a week after we completed most of its legislative work until we have a workable state budget.

Over the past few months, a few education bills have been signed into law by the governor, including
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a5092479af&e=a7ab36849c) that would ensure school board candidates eligible to serve are not listed on the Sex Offender Registry
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=9b4bc73ab0&e=a7ab36849c) that would ensure future school employees disclose criminal convictions before being hired to protect our children
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=da73dbf8c5&e=a7ab36849c) that allows school personnel to administer emergency glucagon per parental permission
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=52d0bcf8ff&e=a7ab36849c) that authorizes a district or charter school enrollment preference to children of families serving our country on active duty or killed in the line of duty,
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=e48d4cae4c&e=a7ab36849c) that requires a noncertificated person who has been disciplined in another jurisdiction for immoral or unprofessional conduct to successfully complete the disciplinary process in that jurisdiction before becoming employed in another district or charter school
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=bbac9ebe06&e=a7ab36849c) that requires an Arizona public university that seeks to transfer monies to a university-recognized organization or club to provide each student with a reasonable opportunity to select student clubs or organizations that may not receive the student's pro rata share of the monies
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c390062359&e=a7ab36849c) that specifies the required instruction on the Holocaust and other genocides must be for at least three school days on at least two separate occasions during any of the 7th-12th grades
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=28b0b87424&e=a7ab36849c) that establishes the Education on the Holocaust and Other Genocides Study Committee
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c8821a4ceb&e=a7ab36849c) that requires each district school governing board and charter school governing body to develop and adopt policies in the transfer of academic credits and educational records for a foster child who is enrolled in grades 9 through 12 and transfers to the school pursuant to a best interest educational placement determination, and
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=af0aab1bed&e=a7ab36849c) that establishes the Purple Star School Program within the Arizona Department of Education to identify schools that provide transition support to military students and their families.

The governor has also used her veto stamp on several education-related bills, including
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6e027785e4&e=a7ab36849c) that establishes November 7 of each year as Victims of Communism Day, a non-legal holiday. Requires public high schools to include instruction on the history of communist regimes around the world as outlined. In the governor’s veto [letter](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=916c580d25&e=a7ab36849c), she said, "the instruction was too prescriptive in dictating curriculum,” but she would “proclaim November 7th Victims of Communism Day.”
* a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8b47897c3e&e=a7ab36849c) that requires district and charter school governing boards to prescribe and enforce policies and procedures that govern student access to the internet and limit student use of wireless communications devices during the school day. In the governor’s veto [letter](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=58514e82ab&e=a7ab36849c), she said this was an “unnecessary mandate schools were already addressing.”

On Monday, the Arizona Supreme Court issued an official statement saying they would release a major decision the following day. On a more personal note, for the past several weeks, we have been securing our home per the Department of Public Safety’s security recommendations knowing our state high court’s decision might come down at any point. The court security and legislature security teams have been great to work and I truly appreciate these men and women.

On Tuesday, shortly after the Arizona Supreme Court issued its [decision](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6813526e95&e=a7ab36849c) in Planned Parenthood’s abortion case, I released a [statement](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2595dae251&e=a7ab36849c) on how the legislature should proceed. When I was recruited back to the legislature, I was asked to make difficult decisions impacting our state. Since I was appointed last year to fill this vacancy, I have conversed with voters in my district of all political persuasions along the campaign trail. If you want to better understand the decision and what it means for Arizona, please take a listen to this local [podcast](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=cd260b7b22&e=a7ab36849c). It is only 20 minutes, but it breaks it down pretty well.

More recently, several center-right supporters asked me to please step up and do something to counter the Abortion Access Act that will be on the November 2024 ballot. From these discussions, it was highly recommended the legislature draft a ballot referral like the 15-week bill signed into law in 2022. With Tuesday’s decision, the legislature can no longer hide behind our courts’ robes. Instead, we all need to work together in the coming weeks to offer voters a choice this coming November.

On Wednesday, while we were at the Capitol, the Senate voted on several House bills before adjourning until Wednesday, April 17th. As you may have heard, the House’s floor unraveled into chaos with emotions running high after the ruling that came down from the court on Tuesday.

On Thursday morning, I served on a bipartisan, cross chamber conference committee to help a former constituent who wanted to be able to keep her backyard chickens via [House Bill 2325](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4cd919c201&e=a7ab36849c). More and more Arizonans want to keep backyard chickens and grow their own food and for good reason.

On Thursday afternoon, the Finance Advisory Committee (FAC) met to discuss the state of the economy. The FAC is not a legislative committee, but a committee the Joint Legislative Budget Committee (JLBC) created several decades ago that meets three times per year and serves as an independent source on the development of our state’s general fund revenues forecast. We are in a $650 million dollar shortfall for the current year instead of $835 million from January 2024, and down to $676 million for the following fiscal year compared to what was previously projected at $879 million back in January. You can tune into April’s FAC [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=cfc6bbf79c&e=a7ab36849c). And [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2ca55cb2f1&e=a7ab36849c) are the briefing materials for April’s meeting. Now, that we have current data points on our state’s economy, hopefully, we can hash out a state budget. Later in the evening, I spent some time celebrating my son’s 22nd birthday along with his fiancée.

Finally, a big thank you to those concerned individuals who have reached out to our household over the past few days to check on us. It really means a lot and we truly appreciate your kind words and support during this critical time in our state’s history. This week a dear friend reminded me to choose the hard right over the easy wrong for the future of our state. With the increase in security threats last week, I cancelled my attendance at public events for the foreseeable future. Thank you for understanding and recognizing our privacy.

Best,
Shawnna

| | **ICYMI**

_It Goes Too Far Campaign_

Considering this week’s Arizona Supreme Court ruling, it is more important than ever to get involved to help educate voters about the “Arizona Abortion Access Act” the Left will be placing on the November 5, 2024, Arizona ballot to allow unrestricted, unregulated abortion on demand up until the moment of birth for the mother’s mental health, an undefined term that has included all factors related to the woman’s well-being, including stress or anxiety.

Arizona currently has many common-sense safety regulations favoring pregnant women. Sadly, these will all be undone if it passes.
You can read this extreme effort for yourself [**HERE**](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f064d389b0&e=a7ab36849c). If this horrific initiative passes, it becomes enshrined into our state’s Constitution making it difficult to undo it or for future legislatures to make **any** changes.

To counter this extreme effort, a campaign called [**“It Goes Too Far”**](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=82f2bfaea3&e=a7ab36849c) has been established. Earlier this year, I attended one of the campaign’s meetings, and here are my main takeaways:
* This constitutional amendment if passed would amend the Arizona Constitution **and** cannot be adjusted by lawmakers to address any future concerns.
* The current safeguards and protections in place right now to protect girls and women seeking an abortion from an abortion clinic would be removed.
* If passed, it would remove the required medical doctor who is trained to handle and detect any complications.
* It prohibits punishment for people who take girls to get an abortion, so if a child is sex trafficked, her trafficker could take the victim to get an abortion to cover their crime, and her parents would never be notified, and they could not be prosecuted.

In 2022, I voted for a 15-week (that’s almost four months) limit bill that was signed into law. If this limit was in place, it would be a better counterpoint to the Left’s extreme Abortion Access Act.

I agree with the counter campaign, this initiative **goes too far**. The way this initiative is drafted it no longer would require a medical doctor to perform or provide the abortion. The language would allow unqualified health care professionals to perform abortions, including chiropractors, podiatrists, and massage therapists, and so on.

_Election Integrity Training to Help Secure Our Elections_

If you are interested in signing up as a poll observer this election cycle, training is currently being scheduled so you will be best equipped for the job. You will receive a comprehensive overview of the state’s election process and the criteria for you to receive an official credential. You will also learn how to observe and report potential issues that may arise during the voting process. If you have not completed a training in 2024, please sign-up for one of the sessions below:

Hi Peter, it’s Jason Kander. I’m the veteran and Democrat who was elected statewide as Missouri’s Secretary of State and then nearly defeated Roy Blunt, an incumbent GOP Senator, in one of the closest races of the 2016 election cycle.
**With Joe Manchin’s retirement taking West Virginia’s Senate race off the board, our Senate race here in Missouri is the perfect candidate to replace it.**
So in a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to join me in supporting Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45357?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ)** But first, please let me explain why I know Lucas has what it takes to flip this Senate seat:

---
If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Multiple polls have already confirmed that this will be a tight race, so your early support could be what helps Lucas tip the scales.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45357?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45358?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45358?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45358?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45358?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45358?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45358?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45357?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ)
---
**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.
**[FIGHT BACK: ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45357?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=18&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ)**
Just as we saw in elections across the country — both last year and in the last decade — pundits and presidential politics won’t be deciding the result of every race in 2024. Voters will be.
**That’s why I’m confident that Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley.**
And with so much at stake in this election — reproductive freedom, health care access, and even our democracy — this race must be a priority.
That’s why I’m asking you today, Peter:

This is one of our best and only opportunities to flip a GOP-held Senate seat in 2024, so I hope you’ll consider adding a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford toward Lucas’ campaign today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45357?refcode=em20240414-5268&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=5268%2E614464%2Ef2ZtEQ)**

Jason Kander

subject: Sunday News Digest: 4/14/2024
body:
Your weekly rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| | [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
| **April 14, 2024**
# **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
### By Heidi Ganahl
---
| Hi there, One of our friends in this conservative movement, Michael Quinn Sullivan, wrote an insightful commentary "[No, They Are Not Mainstream](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)" this week. It delves into the decline of the establishment media and its implications for our republic, which is why we launched Rocky Mountain Voice. The so-called "mainstream" outlets are anything but mainstream, as evidenced by their dwindling sales, market penetration, and economic viability. Rather than serving as impartial purveyors of news, these legacy media organizations often promote a far-left agenda, alienating their audience and driving them away. Sullivan argues that their demise should be cause for celebration, as it signifies a rejection of their biased narratives and misinformation. We agree.
At the Rocky Mountain Voice, we stand as a beacon of truth in a landscape marred by corruption and partisanship. By empowering individuals to become their own media, we can counteract the stranglehold of the establishment media and uphold the principles of transparency and integrity. Together, let's ensure that the voice of the people prevails over the interests of the few. [Read the full commentary here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Wishing you a great week ahead, Heidi Ganahl P.S. From Durango to Fort Morgan, Rocky Mountain Voice is the Voice of rural Colorado! Honored to have our team host a screening of Letter to the American Church up north, and join the Colorado Federation of Republican Women conference down south!
---
| |
---
|
---
# STATE
[**Sen. Bob Gardner fails to qualify for ballot, he announces in letter to supporters**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) State Sen. Bob Gardner has not qualified to appear on the Republican Party's 5th District primary ballot for Congress, ending his campaign.
**[Sen. Rod Pelton warns Kit Carson Republicans of extreme gun bills, appointments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) State Sen. Rod Pelton, R-Cheyenne, warned Kit Carson County Republicans gathered here Friday that they might stay on the lookout for a rash of bills coming through the upper chamber before the state’s legislative session is complete.
[**Ban of so-called ‘assault weapons’ receives initial OK from Colorado Democrats**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) House Democrats on Friday advanced a proposal to ban a long list of “assault” weapons in Colorado following a debate that lasted several hours. **[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
# NATIONAL
**[Illegal immigrants would be banned from boarding commercial flights under GOP bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A senior House Republican is poised to introduce legislation that would ban illegal immigrants from flying into the United States from abroad or from the border without the same documents that the general traveling public must have, the Washington Examiner has learned.
**[Republican lawmakers aim to reverse Biden’s expanded gun background check rule](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Republican senators said Thursday they will pursue legislation to overturn President Biden’s new gun control regulation that would expand the universe of gun sales subject to background checks.
**[Get ready for $5-a-gallon gasoline as result of gains in crude oil pricing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE STREET](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**There’s a chance you will be looking at paying even more than you are now to fill up at a gas station (assuming you aren’t driving an electric vehicle). Don’t be too surprised if you see $5 a gallon or more at the gas pump — if you’re not paying that much already. [**READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
# LOCAL
**[Littleton parents confront school board after bus aide caught on camera hitting boy with autism](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7, LITTLETON](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**More than a dozen parents confronted the Littleton Public Schools Board of Education Thursday night, pushing for change after a school bus paraprofessional was caught on camera hitting a boy with autism.
**[‘How much are we spending on it?’: Denver auditor reviewing costs of city’s homeless shelters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WESTWORD, DENVER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**An audit of Denver’s shelter system and how much the city is actually spending on housing the homeless is in full swing, according to the Denver Auditor’s Office, which hopes to have things wrapped up by late July or early August.
**[El Paso County to consider suing state of Colorado over ‘unconstitutional’ immigration laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE, EL PASO COUNTY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**El Paso County could join a lawsuit against the state of Colorado, challenging laws that stop local governments from cooperating with the federal government in certain matters of immigration. **[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
# COMMENTARY
**[Sullivan: No, they are not ‘mainstream’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [TEXAS SCORECARD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
** _We often hear people refer to the collection of leftist newspapers and television networks that once held sway over the dissemination of facts and opinions as the “mainstream media.” In fact, there is nothing “mainstream” about them._
**[Editorial: Trump abortion policy a turn toward state’s rights](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE EDITORIAL BOARD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
** _The issue: President Donald Trump this week announced his abortion policy, favoring states independently deciding how to regulate abortion. We say: Regardless of your position on abortion, this view respects the concept of state’s rights written into the 10th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution by the Founding Fathers, and is a respectful position for freedom and liberty._
**[The Left’s latest scheme to permanently change elections in America](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
** _Imagine a Super Bowl referee bending the rules to give his favorite team the win. Few would call that fair. Yet that is precisely what the Left wants to do to America’s elections. From noncitizen voting to lawsuits inviting activist judges to rewrite our election laws, left-wing activists are taking every opportunity to change elections permanently for partisan gain._ [**READ MORE COMMENTARY**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming a RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
# 🤔 DID YOU KNOW?

Colorado, Wyoming, and Utah are the only three U.S. states that have only lines of **latitude and longitude for boundaries** and that have no natural borders.

## Israel Weighs Response to Iran Attack
Israeli officials say they're [united in wanting to respond](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGymzAQAL9GdOcRkkBQUKShe2lTMoc40MVC8oiLPc7XZ5z61Vvszv76Wr6QE-fjJ540yV4WDMJPWhy0HRi3uGabdiJDtqGp9a1tBz-4tokTdlb3NG69I1q9pcHgvnXB77jqsVtDw5PRxmnXdnrs-na8eWeGwdvRkvY7ml05TRtLqbffhbNE2tO7PKneQjmbNEWRx6XsD2VmZWaJFDmlD1NmfpTE4a3MzFmoZhQuGZMys-tG29sBItW_5QC-KlKCXAQuojvnA15Y4cUSgStmWP8IoAiGO0S8QAqsBCcJYAilbpyP9NE0ddoeL06Jr94rp48T-X9LI99e-xcAAP__QL9wSg) to Saturday's attack by Iran, even though the U.S. has asked them to hold back and says it won't offer aid in any counterattack. American warships helped Israel shoot down hundreds of Iranian drones and missiles launched in retaliation for Israel destroying Iran's embassy in Syria. Virtually none of the missiles got through and caused damage. [See video here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8GNlvweAE8MHTxlq4dLTCPmAqbyEZB_fsqnbveSSfd1325-1zy8fj0O7mW6uLXll-04CBvA-CCPLpEBKQ4OWmkktZYlHxzXgdtdZjIUBRhBUKIIUkEC6BFQp4dCECB8iamm5bTaBCsNWpSJEzykBgKirnVc_yu-WgbpfJTX3SOa915cVtrz4upDwYzg7n3Poawvh2D-aB-vWE9Sxz2HGOhgfzVBm2tFGqy_HTx2XMp-dKGoXjsPpe_cPt38zcAAP__4n9SEw) President Biden called an emergency meeting of the G7 nations, the world's major democracies, who urged restraint. Biden pledged "ironclad" support for Israel if it's attacked, but [not if it attacks Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvwyAQBeBfgzcs7iDBGRi6eEvXjhYJR3wVAcvguPn3lTt3-ZYnvSe9r-t09Zw4Pz79k1yLZfL3xi-ajISTRDOZLrhIhKQ7cmBBw2AHA93sgrd6gJvBewALaNDfYkAVYgTSNEDHDhUaZeCkLqczXHprcBisvmhSNnqMwigK3MrafxfObaaY3uVFa38vzy65ubWlCv0hcBQ47vve-x8u9UgFjke3wFEdwMGNA2WZqfn89vMmefVZcl09JblVuZfcZN2WpaytW11Ydk6J69kKox5Pz-lvtf37wW8AAAD__8LmXJw) back. Israeli President Isaac Herzog said the country wasn't "seeking war," but the attack had "to be met accordingly."
## Tax Day: Where Does the Money Go?
Today is April 15, the official deadline for Americans to settle their federal taxes with Uncle Sam. Last year, U.S. citizens paid the government [nearly $4 trillion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL9uhSAcRp8GNgx_BQeGLne7XTsaxB9Kg3CDqL1v39i565cv5yTn6zk-XUwxL59uA9tCGZ1v8YRREqYIl6PEsw0AHAQGyzQTzGgjGV5tL_0AzADME-sdqMEY5z31WlA_GTXhaDnlkkqm6KB6NnRacmO0GARQHRwPSFKYYyu1-y4xtxVCepcTaufLhpNdW3vtSHwg_kD8cV1X11aYXHLZw1YyvO8f4g9_1Aq5kYPsJMAM1SWy3Jy83XNzP6TCCfkAIgRVuue42vl1xZTi3msk6bK5mP6s7d8GvwEAAP__Bo9eow) in income and payroll taxes. [This new infographic chart](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71u8yAUQJ8GNiz-EmBg-JZs-daO1o25xLfCxjLEbt--SufO50hH5-M-3oEKrc__sGDsuY4wdTpwtEJdhLaj5SlmRI2GY1ROGeWdt4rPMTi03mXESYNMIeX0ADABkvRKPibgFLXUVlp1keFyVWFwVnvvTDAoXQadmZWYqNd9-Ky09hlz-a4H7sNUF17i3PvWmPnH9I3p23mew0HtBWWCjToUav0tvtGMO4pUsYm6oniJJjp8iVRLgV08K9M3vse0nVQKtatjVj4XoPLb6X9e_wQAAP__Su1aNg) shows where each dollar of tax revenue goes once it reaches the federal budget. Health and Medicare spending account for 28% and Social Security is 22%, making up about half of all federal spending. National defense accounts for 13%, and interest payments on America's outstanding debt are 11%. The rest covers veterans services, transportation, commerce, and other government functions. About two-thirds of taxpayers get a refund back. For those who still have more to pay, here are tips on [how to file for an extension](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAQQH8N3mwdBw72wNCqYkvXjhY1R3IVhsiQr39fNXPnNzy993Vcjp4T59On38i2WBa_Nr7Rons59qgX3QUbiZBUR1YaqeRkJi27sx2BIqGnAwGG2WgzRT9KDQh-nU2Aji0CatByhHk8yHkwGqfJqFkRmOgxCg0UuJV9-Cmc25liepYb7cNati7Zc2uXKtSbQCfQ-e81070Op_KHBbr3a-VMtQp0G-dro775Rx9fNT09GuXKJQt0tZX9KZTjINSHhBkmqXDsdhsud06J68EIDafNc3qZ278ffgMAAP__dAtdlQ).
## Scheffler Takes Home Masters' Victory
Scottie Scheffler, the world's No. 1 golfer, [won his second Masters'](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu6yAUgOGnwRsWHB8bMzDchS137WhRc4ipMERAY-Xtq3Tu_C2__o_bdnMxxXz_704yPZTN7T0-aUMuZw644eBNIAKaBjJSyUmuakU5HAa90j4orYRenFOzU7jOJBSidOpTzEM0IAAFylnoeZF6VAjrqiY9kVDBQWAoyMde6vhVYu4HhfQqT6rjXs4hmaP3R2PTPwaWgb2ua6T2yG9kYO8lBQa29VJfDOzGwEbPwE5aI8oV3raX3iPxth8UQqLKr5gbb7SX7PnpWqfaeIjZJV7Ld_Z8WYdq_OOKKcW2KIbifrqYfnv6n3d-AgAA__8Ii2S5) Tournament by four strokes Sunday, finishing at 11 under par to break out of a crowded field on the back nine. It's only the second major Scheffler's won, both of them at the Masters, but the 27-year-old has been ranked No. 1 for 80 weeks during his career. He was the favorite going into the tournament. Scheffler [shot a 68 Sunday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2upSAYheGrwQ4jCP4UFtPYnWmnNGxYKGcQDHzZZt_9xKlP_ybPyvrztX2ZEEPaf5sTC_m8GUvhjU1xoblUm2rc4gGJvsEiRtGLaZyUaI7Faqec9r6TGLQcJi-Uk5O2Ss2z05NuwiI7qToldDfrQcztqOQ0jf3coxu9kZ6pDi5QLu13DokO-PjJb5TW5rOJy0F0Vdb_YnJlcr3vu7WvWq9cqD4Fk-ueo2dyTbgrk-uj8dNUQqk8wjiUVzbF8TukhMKrzUQBvNoD3senugwFJAv-wg6qvMLm5PhegMS_jf0L4iFxOgrAPzDlcWJ4g8m1KYu77hBjqMPIVLefJsT_0-nHI_8FAAD__14odx8), scoring three birdies heading into the turn, and then another three birdies over the last six holes. He earned $3.6 million for the victory.

body:
Here is a preview of the Q&A in the upcoming Voters' Guide
| | | |
---

---
Hello Peter,
Recently the Las Vegas Review-Journal newspaper asked me three questions. They will include my responses in their Voters' Guide. I was endorsed by the Review-Journal during the last election. Here is a preview of the questions and answers.....
Mark Robertson
1. What would be your top three priorities, if elected, and what specific actions will you take to get them done? (100 word limit) 1. Sponsor legislation to secure our border to stop the flow of guns, gangs, and drugs into our communities, followed by immigration reform that only allows people into our country with the skills we need and who will not require government assistance. 2. Fight to return regular order to our budgeting process, thus controlling spending on our way to a balanced budget. 3. Introduce legislation to protect parents' right to choose which school is best for their child while reducing or eliminating the federal government's role in education. Education funds should follow the child.
2\. What sets you apart from the other candidates? Why should Republican voters pick you? (100 word limit) I have strong ties to our community. I owned a business here and freely give time to community organizations, our church, and local Veteran groups. I served in the Army for 30 years, deploying to ten foreign countries, including combat tours in Afghanistan, Kuwait, and Iraq. I am best positioned to defeat Dina Titus. I received more votes than any other candidate who has faced Titus. In 2022, I beat Titus in Henderson and Boulder City, and by 20 points with in-person voters. My campaign has hundreds of volunteers, thousands of followers, and over 100,000 people who voted for me.
3\. How will you appeal to Nevada's nonpartisan voters? (100 word limit) For the past 32 years, I have worked, played, served, and worshipped with the people in my district regardless of any party affiliation. They know me, and I know them. Through my work with nonprofit organizations such as Opportunity Village, the Salvation Army, and Veteran groups, I have formed friendships with people of all races, religions, national origins, and economic statuses. As a Certified Financial Planner, I worked with teachers, first responders, hotel service workers, blue-collar workers, and people from all walks of life. As a Congressman, I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my district.

*************************************************************************************************

Here are eight great and simple ways to support Mark.
1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail.
2. Follow Mark on Facebook. Click here to go to our campaign page: [Facebook](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YtiPEuzx6XNaV8qFddNqDZ-3PZyus2UqWqLxTcsrgd6ehFERXKBj2_js8JJy05emw9WU_wu6I1Dg_hKBbNELS0h4GeOvRxvFk9uPQraUUttgb5LAQlMQBagj7FTgM4dlzuPHPixN5KkE6xMxQgiFy5Z3NOw9Wk5dBcOMIMx0rLU=&c=v9Sicu_Sa84hWIib1pRryAWX4Eq7rQkYVLWXp_z43LWFApd4obZJWw==&ch=VRbdFTfuapJ6Yk-vMwfFUGrcfsNpGX0CDydebFmvkxfOuwVTrrRf_w==). When you like a post, you can share it with others by simply hitting the "share" button.
3. Host a Meet & Greet. This is the secret behind Mark's success. Last time, he won the Primary election without advertising - it was all word-of-mouth and grassroots-driven. It is not difficult to host a Meet & Greet. Invite some friends and neighbors over to your house or another meeting place. Mark will come to introduce himself and answer questions. You can sign up for a Meet & Greet at this link: [https://calendly.com/robertson-for-congress/meet-and-greet](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YtiPEuzx6XNaV8qFddNqDZ-3PZyus2UqWqLxTcsrgd6ehFERXKBj21TDuSANOXvGGP3jaUYFuVtW1sqJG-FWZguGvk8b766dEZiHBiKJ379rkXRnL_OYhH23PpGxXIfHtyPejZElPBoVZAEYJV_uTAadNWmgUuI8JOwcWMw2CYHPwmBZIbcqhAFHyk8M4tMGVuwiSG5x42I=&c=v9Sicu_Sa84hWIib1pRryAWX4Eq7rQkYVLWXp_z43LWFApd4obZJWw==&ch=VRbdFTfuapJ6Yk-vMwfFUGrcfsNpGX0CDydebFmvkxfOuwVTrrRf_w==)
4. Install a Yard Sign. Enthusiastic volunteers will install a sign in your yard. Call or text this number and leave a message with your address: (818) 932-8050.
5. Invite Mark as a Speaker. If you belong to a group (Book Club, for example), invite Mark to drop by for a few minutes to introduce himself and answer questions. Call or text this number to check his schedule: (702) 379-5704.
6. Knock on Doors. We'll provide you with a list of registered voters in your area so you can leave some literature at their front door. If you feel comfortable, you could ring the doorbell and tell them about Mark. Call or text Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050
7. Make Phone Calls. We'll provide a list of registered voters, their phone numbers, and a simple script. At your convenience, you can call. Most calls go to voicemail, so you can leave a short message encouraging them to vote for Mark. Call Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050
8. Make a Financial Contribution. Mark is very frugal, but it still costs money to purchase signs and literature. You can donate to the campaign at this link: [https://secure.anedot.com/robertson-for-congress/2024-launch](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YtiPEuzx6XNaV8qFddNqDZ-3PZyus2UqWqLxTcsrgd6ehFERXKBj2-YFOBiFjU44whp1ePr0YIjo-pqo1EVDxnBHYFCXBXWBDezBB6ihpGNYQ4ox0CIEnkCU-H3nv8IjXUjYUwVh_CP9_bcFQQma-DciC1dQbva6QB-_nSXVeyN9bpUyqSSjZcy-m4cYt9JX9gfOkm9NzT4=&c=v9Sicu_Sa84hWIib1pRryAWX4Eq7rQkYVLWXp_z43LWFApd4obZJWw==&ch=VRbdFTfuapJ6Yk-vMwfFUGrcfsNpGX0CDydebFmvkxfOuwVTrrRf_w==)
Join Congressman Chris Stewart and Colonel Mark Robertson at an exclusive gathering for supporters on Monday, April 8th, at 6:30 p.m. at the Green Valley Multi-Gen Center, meeting Room A, 250 S. Green Valley Pkwy. Henderson, NV 89012. [Click the link](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YtiPEuzx6XNaV8qFddNqDZ-3PZyus2UqWqLxTcsrgd6ehFERXKBj2wB2bT9Y3iB6NKQ9hBdZrwE1ZdsGPBJ5TQTH6xkCJgtEJS9KfvVNpwTKCegP193Cv-ZLxvWk_Z0CCTMXJAuvXX91gF879biKLaeAHWthW5VnDnmIKjM_rS11T_0SBzCOHeQtH6sRo_C9&c=v9Sicu_Sa84hWIib1pRryAWX4Eq7rQkYVLWXp_z43LWFApd4obZJWw==&ch=VRbdFTfuapJ6Yk-vMwfFUGrcfsNpGX0CDydebFmvkxfOuwVTrrRf_w==) to discover more about this special event and secure your spot.

My campaign has hundreds of volunteers, thousands of followers, and over 100,000 people who voted for me. 3\. How will you appeal to Nevada's nonpartisan voters? (100 word limit) For the past 32 years, I have worked, played, served, and worshipped with the people in my district regardless of any party affiliation. They know me, and I know them. Through my work with nonprofit organizations such as Opportunity Village, the Salvation Army, and Veteran groups, I have formed friendships with people of all races, religions, national origins, and economic statuses. As a Certified Financial Planner, I worked with teachers, first responders, hotel service workers, blue-collar workers, and people from all walks of life. As a Congressman, I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my district. Here are eight great and simple ways to support Mark. 1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail. 2. Follow Mark on Facebook. Click here to go to our campaign page: ==. When you like a post, you can share it with others by simply hitting the "share" button. 3. Host a Meet & Greet. This is the secret behind Mark's success. Last time, he won the Primary election without advertising - it was all word-of-mouth and grassroots-driven. It is not difficult to host a Meet & Greet. Invite some friends and neighbors over to your house or another meeting place. Mark will come to introduce himself and answer questions. You can sign up for a Meet & Greet at this link: == 4. Install a Yard Sign. Enthusiastic volunteers will install a sign in your yard. Call or text this number and leave a message with your address: (818) 932-8050. 5. Invite Mark as a Speaker. If you belong to a group (Book Club, for example), invite Mark to drop by for a few minutes to introduce himself and answer questions. Call or text this number to check his schedule: (702) 379-5704. 6. Knock on Doors. We'll provide you with a list of registered voters in your area so you can leave some literature at their front door. If you feel comfortable, you could ring the doorbell and tell them about Mark. Call or text Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050 7. Make Phone Calls. We'll provide a list of registered voters, their phone numbers, and a simple script. At your convenience, you can call. Most calls go to voicemail, so you can leave a short message encouraging them to vote for Mark. Call Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050 8. Make a Financial Contribution. Mark is very frugal, but it still costs money to purchase signs and literature. You can donate to the campaign at this link: == Join Congressman Chris Stewart and Colonel Mark Robertson at an exclusive gathering for supporters on Monday, April 8th, at 6:30 p.m. at the Green Valley Multi-Gen Center, meeting Room A, 250 S. Two years
ago, The Babylon Bee was suspended from Twitter for
"misgendering" Admiral Rachel Levine.

We were
given the following choice from the content moderators at
Twitter: Remove the tweet and check a box admitting we
participated in hate speech, or lose our platform.

Here is
the internal conversation we had where we decided how we would
respond:

We
decided to stand for the truth, because the truth is not hate
speech.

We had no
idea that this decision would play a role in one of the biggest
wins for free speech in years.

It wasn't
long after we refused to censor ourselves that Elon Musk bought
Twitter, changed his bio to "Chief Twit," and issued an urgent
directive: "Bring back the Babylon Bee." He then changed the
platform's name to X and has committed to making it the freest
place for truth-tellers on the internet.

Our
commitment to you, our readers, is this: we will never back down
from this fight. The truth is worth it, and always will be.

Since
we're fighting a constant battle for the right to tell our jokes,
we depend on support from our fans to keep our operation going.
To that end, would you consider becoming a Babylon Bee
subscriber?

Supporting members of The Babylon Bee not only get extra content,
ad-free browsing, and access to our awesome Bee community, they
help us to continue to take the fight to the woke left that hates
you and wants to shut down platforms where free speech can expose
their bad ideas. You empower us to take big, bold stands for free
speech like this one.

Freedom
is worth fighting for. If you agree, stand with us and help us
fight back against the forces that would silence you if they had
the chance. At the very least, you'll help us pay for our insane
DoorDash bill.

STAND
WITH US

Kyle Mann

Dear Peter,
The headline said it all:
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=housing_4_15_24_rs_nd1&n=3)
Biden’s response comes, no doubt, on the heels of RFK Jr.’s simple plan to make housing affordable for first-time homebuyers.
RFK Jr.’s plan: Tax-free 3% government-backed mortgage bonds.
_3% tax-free loans_. Straight up, simple. Transformative.
RFK Jr.’s vision restores the American Dream by helping millions of young people secure home ownership–private property–for the very first time.
The Biden plan “smacks of pure politics.”
And it clearly highlights the inadequacy of his plan in addressing the soaring costs of housing.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zb2u4vjin0r153s6kvlk8fup71b456lhou5b4760_rp22sh2s8i6ep36chie6pr4c5h2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr82hgb004pr5m76q72sctunf42ip2g4hk6r01s0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36chie6pr4c5h2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z95itvuoms8el5t8k9bdg3p4686fmlfbcbljg85g_rp22sh2s8i6ep36chie6pr4c5h2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

Thank you for subscribing & staying subscribed!
---
| | | **
OHIO ELECTION INTEGRITY BILL
HR 472 • HR 472 • HR 472
WHAT TO KNOW! • WHAT TO DO!**

---
|
Members of the Ohio Election Integrity Network (OEIN) have been working almost non-stop for months on election integrity legislation that has recently been introduced in the Ohio House of Representatives as HB 472. You can find information on the bill [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=0934f060c3&e=5c740fa3e2).

Soon, they'll be asking you to take action, BUT NOT YET. For now, be aware of it, study it, ask questions about it, and share it with others.

A summary of HB 472 can be downloaded in PDF format by clicking [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=53b985885c&e=5c740fa3e2) or by clicking on the image below.

If you have any questions, please contact **Mark Pukita** at **614-499-0599 (c)** by text or call. I will put you in touch with the right people to answer your questions.

**EVENT NOTICE! • CONSIDER ATTENDING****!
OHIO REPUBLICAN PARTY
STATE CENTRAL COMMITTEE
ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING
APRIL 26TH! • FREE!
PLEASE FORWARD & SHARE!**

---
|
**Reserve Friday, April 26th! **This is the date of the Organizational Meeting of the newly-elected Ohio Republican Party State Central Committee (ORP SCC). _**THE MEETING IS OPEN TO THE PUBLIC AND WE NEED YOU THERE!**_

This elected body (you voted for them, or should have, on March 19th!) represents you in the Ohio Republican Party. Grassroots, citizen candidates widened their share of the SCC to almost equal with the old-time, elite, insiders. This is GREAT news for those of us working to take back our communities, state, and nation from corrupt career politicians and party insiders & operatives.

I'll be sending out another of these emails soon to tell you what you can do to help advance the conservative cause within the ORP. Be on the lookout for it!

THANK YOU!
---
|
---
|
---
| |
**ANNOUNCING: THE OHIO X BRIGADE!
JOIN US ON X (formerly Twitter)!
FREE SPEECH SOCIAL MEDIA!**

---
|
**X (formerly "Twitter") is the only large free speech social media platform!**
Since Elon Musk purchased Twitter and renamed it X, it has become the only widely-used, free speech, social media platform. Truth may have free speech, but it has very few users compared to X (or Facebook, or Instagram, or ...) and is an echo chamber for conservatives.

**Why be on X?**

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32165%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=R71ZT1w7O%2fF1qs%2bwjLAfWA&sysid=1) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32166%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1esQfykmgF%2fYtsEVFQl4ew&sysid=1) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including “The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,” “Ancient Christianity,” and “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”) consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we’ve seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32166%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1esQfykmgF%2fYtsEVFQl4ew&sysid=1) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Your America News

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Referendum
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z860rmm2oosv1i7nij5e288ile4dg7mpchc09k48_rp22sh2s8i6ep36chie9pb4c1h2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zol5q3shvcasno4t3lrhi59e42hf9g5mq1o9a6tg_rp22sh2s8i6ep36chie9pb4c1h2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcl34co93uuhrs03tk7rjkpk8449m34e1s72h70o_rp22sh2s8i6ep36chie9pb4c1h2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| American Briefing

We attended with several Indigenous, Black land defenders and allies from across Turtle Island (North America) Thursday’s RBC Annual General Meeting, where we were met with interruptions, censorship, and silencing from the RBC board despite the importance of the questions raised around human rights, Indigenous sovereignty and its reckless investments in fossil fuels. This leads me to a very important issue, we have to hold the banks, insurance company, government, the corporation itself and asset management companies for funding the Mountain Valley Pipeline (MVPP) and Southgate Extension accountable. These businesses has made numerous commitments about fighting climate change and advancing truth and reconciliation. They tell us climate change is one of the most pressing issues of our age and that each of these corporations has an important role in supporting the most significant economic transition in centuries. These corporations also commit to acting on reconciliation in genuine and meaningful ways. But their non existent actions speak louder than words. That is why we are holding a Rights of Nature Tribunal. This Tribunal will examine systemic Rights of Nature based alternatives to the false solutions and failed negotiations of the MVP and governing states. Along with Nature, and Land Defenders we have been successful in delaying this project. These delays contributed to MVP’s estimated cost ballooning between $5.8 billion and $6 billion. That’s nearly double the $3.5 billion reported during our last briefing. The companies behind MVP also announced plans to spend another $500 million to increase the pipeline’s gas pressure. This would increase the volume of fracked gas transported per day and with it, the pipeline’s climate damage. This brings the potential project cost to between $6.3 billion and $6.5 billion. Even without the capacity increase and recent cost explosion, MVP has already ranked as the most expensive pipeline project on a cost-per-mile basis.

subject: Friend, Happy Tax Day! Did you know that your taxes are set to increase next year?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY PAUL HUDSON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Today is tax day, so millions of Americans are feeling the squeeze of writing another check to the government even as high inflation has made everyday life unaffordable.
| | |
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UEVbow8J6tLl5FodLjZ8r4V6oXQLVy9RVI9wEO3eYpytqDk27bLGUYNZ1YmXWewitAfIonr-l_eZml2EYa71ppkZGzicGLZZFmaYyovsxfwwoob53C3cPGLvhSCafC1As9-u6WcaWD2JBda9_adsSbruiksLxZT9&c=v5dglGZYpeGNGEiecmJGkYlCRqRfbdFXOxqEmo8zOPdwkU-S5_OgGw==&ch=o3g8WbjgOHHbB2Cr6QgdbfhkRfefh3oXbRI1t0_qnsdOoa868sq6DA==)

|
Friend
Today is tax day, so millions of Americans are feeling the squeeze of writing another check to the government even as high inflation has made everyday life unaffordable.
What many people don't realize is that things are about to get even worse, with taxes set to automatically go up next year, with the expiration of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act at the end of 2025.
This will affect basically every taxpayer, with marginal rates jumping and the standard deduction cut nearly in half. All told, normal West Michigan families are set to pay thousands more in taxes.
---
| That's the last thing we need right now, with inflation raging and the typical Michigander paying over $10,000 per year more on basic essentials than we did just a few years ago. Think about it this way.
Last year, the typical American had to work almost 108 days just to pay their taxes, which means the average wage earner spent more than a quarter of the year working just to cover their tax bill. That's a startling fact, and a good reminder to lawmakers in Washington that hiking taxes means their constituents have to work even harder just to keep up.
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UEVbow8J6tLl5FodLjZ8r4V6oXQLVy9RVI9wEO3eYpytqDk27bLGUewhnyf4jZhB2VFoHTdZRD1W_SfpwY5t8OnpDVXrloID5aBmUNub4Zy9enNP-EabMuE3bprG7dVfTc6g0mpLpyVf0gkH-ZwzmYabIBvnFTV-WKXZM1W1HydPNQK4SBkGQzevMh-0GePLdOtzDzuQzx8iI7ZwliRMKEwjWf-VKyzAew0yGuEhbdOAyl6t2IzKpzBO42roGtfl_kHxSVxNxjw=&c=v5dglGZYpeGNGEiecmJGkYlCRqRfbdFXOxqEmo8zOPdwkU-S5_OgGw==&ch=o3g8WbjgOHHbB2Cr6QgdbfhkRfefh3oXbRI1t0_qnsdOoa868sq6DA==)
---
| Look, we all recognize our civic duty to pay taxes to fund our government, but that comes with it a duty by the government to spend those tax dollars wisely.
This is a real difference between me and my opponent. Representative Scholten talks a good game, claiming as recently as this weekend that she is a 'TRUE fiscal conservative.' But what irks her constituents is that her actions don't match the rhetoric.
A true fiscal conservative would oppose higher taxes, would oppose the Biden administration's proposed $7.3 trillion spending plan and corresponding tax hikes, and would vote to extend the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act to provide tax relief for her constituents.

# The Story of Kate Cox

Peter- women's rights are non-negotiable.
The ability to control decisions about our own bodies isn't just a matter of policy; it's a fundamental aspect of our humanity.
[**Be sure to watch the video below to learn about Kate Cox's story and understand why women's autonomy is of utmost importance.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=653b0992d4&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=a86a3de7fc&e=a2a46ff12c)
Every person, regardless of gender, deserves the autonomy to access necessary healthcare without fear or interference.
Take the story of Kate Cox, for instance. She had to leave Texas to receive essential care, illustrating the pressing nature of this issue. Countless others like her might find themselves in similar predicaments, forced to choose between their health and the limitations of state laws.
**If elected, I promise to be a voice for women's bodily autonomy.**
I'll fight tirelessly to ensure that every woman's right to make choices about her own body is not only respected but fiercely protected.
I'm ready to champion the rights of women across the United States.
[**Let's rally for a future where every woman can make decisions about her health without hindrance**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=0beff83b6e&e=a2a46ff12c)**.**

body:
Pass the stand-alone funding bill now
| | | |

|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **** Over the weekend Israel was attacked by Iran, with weapons being fired from Iran, Iraq, Yemen, and Syria. Again, we stand with our allies and the people of Israel. Again, no other country is attacked like this simply for existing, year after year, after year. [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947c5c824b/1edb97947c5ba06d) **** ************
---
| |
---
| **** ******Our call to action today is to call your representative and both of your senators and tell them to pass aid for Israel. We are asking for different bills in each chamber, which we will explain below.**
* **When you call the House:** Tell your representative to pass a clean, stand-alone Israel aid bill, and to reject the Senate bill that includes aid to other countries; we just want a clean bill that sends aid to Israel.

* **When you call the Senate:** Tell both of your senators to demand that Sen. Schumer take up the House-passed stand-alone Israel aid bill that includes the pay-for through IRS reductions.
[****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947c5c824b/1edb97947c5ba06f) **** ************

---
| **** Additionally, the history of the Israel aid bills is a little bit confusing. [**We put together a summary**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947c5c824b/1edb97947c5ba075 "We put together a summary") to explain what occurred before and the current situation.
**Explanation of two bills:** It is a long-shot that the Senate will pass a bill that is paid for, but that is our first choice. Therefore, we want to make sure the Senate is receiving pressure to pass the bill already passed by the House. However, we also want to make sure Israel gets the help it so desperately needs, so we are asking the House to pass a clean, stand-alone Israel aid bill. It's convoluted, but that's the reality of the Congress we are currently stuck with. Thank you for standing with Israel! In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947c5c824b/1edb97947c5ba077) **** ************

This can’t go on.

**That’s why I’ve filed crucial lawsuits to FREE January 6 peaceful protesters. And their criminal trials MUST STOP.**

I’m Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 41 years.

You’ve seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I’m the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with this critically important case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can **now**.

In Justice,

Larry Klayman
Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc.

The 2024 and 2026 election cycles are Texas Democrats’ best chance in over a generation to win statewide office if we expand our source of support.

Keep the faith and Onward!

Joe Jaworski
