**[Please give a crucial $25, $50, $100, or more IMMEDIATELY to fully fund my critical, class action lawsuits and hard-hitting legal actions to FREE ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zavhev5crs6fjirttkeoap2aqp3dqa157f3d5lco_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9g6cp36c3h2bs)**

Over a year ago, I wrote an urgent email to patriots just like you about what’s really happening to January 6 Peaceful Protesters in the Washington, DC jail.

**Patriot, what’s being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba ...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I’m heartsick and deeply angry about what’s being done to our fellow patriots.

Their letter reads like an appeal from dissidents in the Soviet Union.

Here are just a few examples of what they’re enduring (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* **Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy****through a 4 inch by 10 inch window of cold metal doors**
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

But there’s more.

**Guards deny them hot water, and keep them from going to court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for years ... in AMERICA.

**They conclude their letter by pleading to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where the Taliban and Islamic terrorists get better treatment!**

This can’t go on.

**That’s why I’ve filed crucial lawsuits to FREE January 6 peaceful protesters. Including a critical new lawsuit that PROVES the FBI and other agencies carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE on January 6 patriots. That means their criminal convictions can be THROWN OUT. And their criminal trials MUST STOP.**

I’m Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 41 years.

You’ve seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I’m the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with this critically important case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

**[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $$25, $50, $100, or even more.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlt6up445q7kjvl8cfojtj2qlrn2hohnh01qc2qo_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9g6cp36c3h2bs)**

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can **now**.

In Justice,

Larry Klayman
Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc.

**P.S. Patriot, innocent Americans are begging for water in the Washington, DC jail. These innocent men and women are being tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

**[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $25, $50, $100, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Every dollar counts.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zf11ao6drj2n7lpldhcmleshu301q59ebc0fhkb0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c9g6cp36c3h2bs)**

| | | With most of the world trying to contain the fighting in the middle east, Congressional Republicans are pouring gasoline on the fire by pushing for America to attack Iran. [**Don't let Republicans push us into war with Iran.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6bbbceed-7f6a-45e7-8cbd-92b47699602e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Multiple Republican [Senators](https://default.salsalabs.org/T652ea3b9-8b8e-475b-9d83-816a3a7f6dfb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), including Lindsey Graham, John Cornyn, and Marsha Blackburn, have demanded the US launch immediate attacks against Iran -- putting us in open war with that nation. There are plenty of reasons to oppose the theocratic thugs governing Iran, and to take steps to oppose their actions. But the last thing we need is an all-out war, and an attack should be the last resort, not the first. And when even Tucker Carlson says you're "[****ing lunatics](https://default.salsalabs.org/T43a96567-bfaf-44bd-8668-272ee99583ee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)" for suggesting it, you know you've really gone too far. body:
Here's an update from another week on the campaign trail. | | | | |
---
There’s a lot of coming up in Wisconsin, and it’s going to be here before we know it.
_The Republican National Convention is in 91 days.__The Packer’s first game is in 144 days.__The General Election is in 204 days._
Here’s an update from another week on the campaign trail.
**New Attack Ad** This week, House Democrats’ top campaign committee bought digital ads attacking me for my work on election integrity.
They’re attacking me for two main reasons.
1. In Congress, I introduced the most conservative election integrity legislation in 20 years, which aims to boost voter confidence and encourage more states to implement commonsense election integrity reforms. [**Click here to read more about my bill**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=c4a9a532e5&e=e907534017).

2. Two weeks ago, I helped lead the fight in Wisconsin to pass Constitutional Amendments that would **ban private money and political operatives from influencing future election administration in Wisconsin**.

We’ve been winning on this issue. That’s why Democrats are attacking me.
Despite their attacks, **I’m going to continue working hard to make it easy to vote and hard to cheat**.
**1st District Caucus** This weekend, I enjoyed attending the 1st District Republican Caucus in Waterford.
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
Wisconsin’s First Congressional District is one of the most critical swing districts in the country. This November, our district will determine control of the House, Senate, and Presidency.
Our volunteers from Kenosha, Racine, Rock, Walworth, and Milwaukee counties are fired up and ready to win in November. I’m enormously grateful for all their hard work and support.
**Countdown to Convention** The Republican National Convention is coming to Milwaukee in less than 100 days!
I’m excited for the opportunity to welcome over 50,000 guests to Milwaukee. It will be a great opportunity to show off Wisconsin to the rest of the world.
Are you interested in getting involved with the convention?
[**Click this link if you’d like to volunteer during the convention!**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=08534fb159&e=e907534017)
Do you or someone you know own a local business you’d like to market during convention week?
[**Click here to register your business as an official vendor for the convention!**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=26539b0c1a&e=e907534017)

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

subject: ICYMI: More spending and higher taxes are not the answer
body:
Read my op/ed in today’s Detroit News | | | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=661d33348cd59d680b6a0a47&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D661cf18adda19219a95ceb75%26ss_email_id%3D661d33348cd59d680b6a0a47%26ss_campaign_name%3DICYMI%253A%2BMore%2Bspending%2Band%2Bhigher%2Btaxes%2Bare%2Bnot%2Bthe%2Banswer%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-04-15T14%253A05%253A10Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_661cf18adda19219a95ceb75&l=en-US&s=BBXY6FABQWxiLt-HnCEcTC1vI_Y%3D)
---
| | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=661d33348cd59d680b6a0a47&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F04%2F14%2Fbarrett-more-spending-and-higher-taxes-are-not-the-answer%2F73303443007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_661cf18adda19219a95ceb75&l=en-US&s=h7ogg57rA5egXo-y4_xzx1Ls4Ac%3D)
---
Read my op/ed in The Detroit News online [here](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=661d33348cd59d680b6a0a47&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F04%2F14%2Fbarrett-more-spending-and-higher-taxes-are-not-the-answer%2F73303443007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_661cf18adda19219a95ceb75&l=en-US&s=h7ogg57rA5egXo-y4_xzx1Ls4Ac%3D).
---
As Americans rush to file their taxes Monday, we should all take a minute to ask ourselves if what we are paying in taxes is fair, if we are getting the services we’re paying for, and if everything we are paying for is even necessary?My answer is no, no and no.Government spending is out of control. As its size and scope continues to swell into every aspect of our lives, it demonstrates little ability to navigate basic governmental functions. Property crime is rising in major cities, some of which have seen huge spikes in murders; gas prices, grocery prices, insurance costs, even fast-food prices are exploding due to record inflation over the past two years; mortgage interest rates, increased property values, even higher home insurance put affordable housing even further out of reach. Families are struggling to get by — let alone get ahead.The U.S. national debt is nearing $35 trillion, and that eye-popping number is not coming down anytime soon. Quite the opposite — it continues to grow.
---
[_ _ Donate _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=661d33348cd59d680b6a0a47&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftax-day&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_661cf18adda19219a95ceb75&l=en-US&s=vIFjm9r3vsRodsZcm_vtgeTWkGQ%3D)
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=661d33348cd59d680b6a0a47&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F04%2F14%2Fbarrett-more-spending-and-higher-taxes-are-not-the-answer%2F73303443007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_661cf18adda19219a95ceb75&l=en-US&s=h7ogg57rA5egXo-y4_xzx1Ls4Ac%3D)
---
Servicing the federal debt (the interest paid) is projected to be an astonishing $870 billion in 2025 — more than 10 times the size Michigan’s entire annual budget, taking money away from critical services.While Biden and congressional Democrats propose trillions in new taxes to fund their budgetary brinksmanship, our foreign adversaries are banding together to create a new world reserve currency that would devastate the dollar.Here in Michigan, Democrats were “proud” to announce the largest budget in state history at $82 billion — a $23 billion increase during the Whitmer administration. And if you watched the governor’s State of the State speech, it was a laundry list of new spending proposals that will ultimately be thrown on the backs of Michigan taxpayers.Let’s be honest. Republicans and Democrats are responsible for the mess we are in. And honesty is required if we are going to avert this imminent disaster.
---
[_ _ Donate _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=661d33348cd59d680b6a0a47&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftax-day&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_661cf18adda19219a95ceb75&l=en-US&s=vIFjm9r3vsRodsZcm_vtgeTWkGQ%3D)
---
I spent eight years in the Michigan House and Senate, while serving in the Michigan National Guard. After 22 years of service in the U.S. Army, including the Iraq War, I retired to run for Congress. The disastrous Afghanistan withdrawal was the final straw, but I am ultimately running as the father of four young kids deeply concerned about the lack of opportunities we are leaving for them.I was an opponent of increased spending and higher taxes in the legislature and my record reflects that. I took a lot of criticism for voting against popular spending programs, including corporate subsidies that are now funding the Chinese Communist Party-influenced Gotion EV battery company.We have to be honest about what’s happening in Washington, and we must protect the people we are running to represent. That means hard truths about spending, taxes and services. But until we stop treating taxpayers as ATMs while making it harder for them to get by, our problems are only going to get worse.Today, I am signing the Americans for Tax Reform’s Taxpayer Protection Pledge and am committing myself to stopping the out-of-control spending that has put our nation on a perilous fiscal cliff and challenge every candidate to join me.
---

name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: Back the Blue
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW3_V6qiNo

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW3_V6qiNo

Friend,

I am so
grateful for our police officers.

As an
American who believes in law and order, truth, and justice, I
have always stood with the public servants who protect our
communities.

Please
join me in thanking uniformed men and women by signing our 'Back
the Blue Petition' and letting brave officers know that we are
grateful for their service and sacrifice.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began propelling
criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to "defund the
police."

I refuse
to accept that we must cater to the bottom denominator of our
society and that the black community must fight and scream and
demand support for the people in our community who are up to no
good.

That's
one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT - an organization focused on
shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and
uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of
community service.

Around
the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers,
while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve
our communities.

To join
these chapters and stand with police officers, please sign the
national petition today.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

This
summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving back to the
Baltimore Police Department and learned some history about the
city's police force.

The first
state chapter - BLEXIT North Carolina - paid a visit to local
officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you
notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT's appreciation.

If you
'Back the Blue' - and believe that we must support local heroes -
please sign the national petition right away.

While the
'defund the police' crowd wants us to think minorities stand with
them - polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more
than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase.

We've
been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals - those lies have
been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a
whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day.

We must
stop the deception that is harming urban communities and
demeaning police around the nation.

If you
are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want
law and you should want order. That is the way forward.

Join me
in letting our police officers know that you support law and
order, justice, and their valiant efforts to keep our communities
safe.

Sign the
'Back the Blue Petition'

Candace
Owens
Chair of
BLEXIT
Powered
by Turning Point USA

body:
When you hired me as State Treasurer in 2020, I made a promise - now I’m ready to do it again as your next U.S. Representative for West Virginia Congressional District 2.

| [](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2ed1c0fa80494cafbfc2ad79aee110ba&_e=wOoohnkm7TRCXsZhjqYbyZyALUY2fXPseeBqgg9ggG7PBN9CznP33f3BFbzncmzMueuvX_BtBqYOkT997U79ZGerDDOfuCqBYW0D35gyjveFPueU4oZzcl5XQ5RdALP3ajU65lMA5iawlnmGb87eSzOu91IQbiNTc_TlFH5fT3cF9PFNvn5C478-esKyQhMkOXY7NX6-7PLKR22sW4TWh47YmNPPPa84wXs4K-InwH8N0pC2eaIybCd85y8-ysYvGwqjp-2jybicLXuv6hrkz0mJzP1dpSkbDZ-m_r3gWD5-P42SyUT5hjWq8PS-8O8gtGbqweqO0q5WCMoIRKAlo_NERfNSwWD9FydQRuGNTo0HoRSRB5dNOf7-1XGJWKFka2ze5MEoqeHBcQBXj6we2w%3D%3D)
---
Fellow American,

I made a promise when you hired me as State Treasurer four years ago. As the next U.S. Representative for West Virginia’s 2nd Congressional District (God willing), I’m ready to do it again.

I promised you that I would get to work for all West Virginians and deliver on our shared goals; goals that will take our state from good to great, and make it the best place for people to live, work, and raise their families.

As I run for a new office, I promise to continue pushing West Virginia to be the best it can be. I’m prepared to fight for you by working to:

* Decrease inflation and put hard-earned dollars back into the pockets of Americans

* Invest in our teachers and children so the next generation can reach their full potential (no more CRT curriculum in schools)

* Put our economy back on track & get folks back to work

* Secure our border to STOP the drugs, crime, and human trafficking poisoning our communities

* Support law enforcement and our military, who work to keep us safe at home and overseas

| [**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2ed1c0fa80494cafbfc2ad79aee110ba&_e=wOoohnkm7TRCXsZhjqYbyZyALUY2fXPseeBqgg9ggG7PBN9CznP33f3BFbzncmzMueuvX_BtBqYOkT997U79ZGerDDOfuCqBYW0D35gyjveFPueU4oZzcl5XQ5RdALP3ajU65lMA5iawlnmGb87eSzOu91IQbiNTc_TlFH5fT3cF9PFNvn5C478-esKyQhMkS9J5jmvaZJPmveGRTZa7pfUofNN5pA6_3NS74V1ctGpbaIfvfQ17xQg7W7qD9qacRl1yLMxlQ-UEWbu_TmGBtNBVhphHyxGoMmjlJsSFby-xb1x0iZi4T7mfIE4eZWMlBvNHaHGQDHvGDocNoBuFE4mJIw1kORqiA6-lD6NUCywnSQMOmtqExx_YUSG9h0YThrl6saWb7XioIQXePzaVYg%3D%3D)
---

We can do all of this together, not because of partisan views, but because we know these common sense solutions will deliver the best results for all of West Virginia and America.

All of these shared goals are at risk from the far Left Democrats who are trying to take control of the House, Senate, and White House in 2024. They are trying to lead West Virginia and America down a path toward higher taxes, higher crime, higher inflation, unsafe communities, and fewer jobs.

As your next Congressman, I refuse to let that happen. I’m not going to stand by and let them steal your paychecks and raise your taxes to fund their bogus plans. I’m not going to let our border remain wide open and crime flood into our communities. I’m not going to let them take jobs out of West Virginia.

I promise to find common-sense solutions to defend West Virginia and prevent the Left from tearing apart the American Dream even further. I appreciate your support as I aim to deliver on these promises.

[**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2ed1c0fa80494cafbfc2ad79aee110ba&_e=wOoohnkm7TRCXsZhjqYbyZyALUY2fXPseeBqgg9ggG7PBN9CznP33f3BFbzncmzMueuvX_BtBqYOkT997U79ZGerDDOfuCqBYW0D35gyjveFPueU4oZzcl5XQ5RdALP3ajU65lMA5iawlnmGb87eSzOu91IQbiNTc_TlFH5fT3cF9PFNvn5C478-esKyQhMkS9J5jmvaZJPmveGRTZa7pfUofNN5pA6_3NS74V1ctGpTQBhZt5hfy0aLsZYmSugNAxE3MdKNU_l6IP8nrzGn-55u-c22zCpdUqutRLzVFEWrzlTSeX1CFFUf66uUWSAvUVPC5LuNRnfjSf-kc7FbktA-lzGTbyM1D0BgoFIGW-wKHElETGWJKPxp6_559tbpVdvDL27rSoYL2oYgePL3lQ%3D%3D)
---

Thank you for your support,

Riley Moore

|
**RILEY MOORE: CONSERVATIVE FOR CONGRESS.**

* * *
Washington is all tied up in putting politics over principle.
It’s time to put a stop to it and start putting PRINCIPLES OVER POLITICS - starting with YOU!

[](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2ed1c0fa80494cafbfc2ad79aee110ba&_e=wOoohnkm7TRCXsZhjqYbyZyALUY2fXPseeBqgg9ggG7PBN9CznP33f3BFbzncmzMueuvX_BtBqYOkT997U79ZGerDDOfuCqBYW0D35gyjveFPueU4oZzcl5XQ5RdALP3ajU65lMA5iawlnmGb87eSzOu91IQbiNTc_TlFH5fT3cF9PFNvn5C478-esKyQhMky8LImCl6mLTvSkipJBQHmxZ1qRDw2L5SGJalQFIIM9InnexSwwtu5FwFzpfzZAQDtKIDIMNEn3OHvfVmzxQR0X7wQWSrnhxpdNMU84J8oKQlPT6oLImlBQqBjmtM7RM3BvbQIXRV1EqzafkYgqL61sBXG_ZRHELk-0zYJ-T93sYSFSMBPKVmnLtXGbWI5hBv)

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7c138d1d-1a98-4903-a4d0-c6ba117a9a44/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdfa67829-2dc8-44be-9140-04406d243cc8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I’m always saying that my campaign to keep representing Alaska in Congress is a tossup. Here’s what that _really_ means:
* I have **multiple opponents already running against me,** and there’s still plenty of time for more opponents to jump in the race.
* **Every single vote I take in Washington is scrutinized,** spun, and used to attack me by those who want to unseat me.
* **Dark money groups are digging through video clips of me as we speak,** trying to find footage of me saying things they can use in attack ads and take out of context.
* Special interest groups are already **blasting me in attack ads,** and spending money to lay the groundwork for my defeat.

**Peter, running in such a competitive race is exhausting, stressful, and challenging. But I’m up for the challenge because there’s few things I love more than giving Alaskans a seat at the table in Washington**. I’m in this no matter the odds, but I can only win with your support, Peter – because we can only defeat these special interest millions together. [**Can you split a donation of $25 between Blue Amp Action and I before midnight to help me win this competitive seat again and fend off these constant attacks? >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tadc8f586-d5f2-4325-b9d0-d6662d7103b4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Ted Cruz

name: Hillsdale College via Defend the Constitution
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9daf6e6982b742d8937076156c58a766&_e=4Wv0CakUXwkrRWDHHYbNIrldB2VjwPyMlISA60CA-Ryfwf-3ChsPAr6vryZ_recTK980lIeAyqJO1gO7grPe-PkjS6suZAfcTVzBWkN-nU8rjce3EHO_XvX0LnrgktI3zPT98XVOoxueRwWRL0jXr4N9Upbcm5ARzjikj17wOTBKpjD-LXE82gwOuh7-jBMp3yWzrbwcJr73v3cXUTHMrBZF49dYHPMbmYJ3_lXwfE8b8McCtQi0QFCRDicI9mL6qFfYEv1vneIw90g3epp9-pTPQpxa6wccMHSXiqundnJKIeSuzkH4cZsbICJLsnQ2fYc7LaI3hEEGbyK3rAKPgOUBt7KRfUZ9NLGUWJ1KQvzp6Ttw5VpCH1OnK6RCmPCYbNGHtLoheBsZAJoxAkNZDA%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9daf6e6982b742d8937076156c58a766&_e=4Wv0CakUXwkrRWDHHYbNIrldB2VjwPyMlISA60CA-Ryfwf-3ChsPAr6vryZ_recTK980lIeAyqJO1gO7grPe-PkjS6suZAfcTVzBWkN-nU8rjce3EHO_XvX0LnrgktI3zPT98XVOoxueRwWRL0jXr4N9Upbcm5ARzjikj17wOTBKpjD-LXE82gwOuh7-jBMp3yWzrbwcJr73v3cXUTHMrBZF49dYHPMbmYJ3_lXwfE8b8McCtQi0QFCRDicI9mL6cLxuOOTJzR1hQnkvq6WcLv_Cr-U7raCN43UhcK_kQB-rmiHgs3TTZhIywB_cpccurEryL2DL60LBKYCCuKlOVK70vIhatqQSCjuid85_azXrn6xAfgCLrGbDQ7qoo37tE1tZvY2GtMgsfbqFwliS7A%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9daf6e6982b742d8937076156c58a766&_e=4Wv0CakUXwkrRWDHHYbNIrldB2VjwPyMlISA60CA-Ryfwf-3ChsPAr6vryZ_recTK980lIeAyqJO1gO7grPe-PkjS6suZAfcTVzBWkN-nU8rjce3EHO_XvX0LnrgktI3zPT98XVOoxueRwWRL0jXr4N9Upbcm5ARzjikj17wOTBKpjD-LXE82gwOuh7-jBMp3yWzrbwcJr73v3cXUTHMrBZF49dYHPMbmYJ3_lXwfE8b8McCtQi0QFCRDicI9mL6gnCoeiWG3uNhIw3rTp9GKz_vjTZIs1HDapFbb-pFUsjh9PcbHGgn0QJ-JEwaZv3bhLNmjrDb_KUkW-CIz6WibNyKzFfPko4JI8LfI6I50bia_V3ZV_AbyFgPLC__9kb-a2cDfmNhFr2Be3I4B3-qsw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

# **Repeal the DEI Tax**
_Vikram Mansharamani_
The adoption of [diversity, equity, and inclusion](https://substack.com/redirect/a79f1387-a559-48b9-a349-763cc4fdcead?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) strategies at the expense of profit generation has imposed an unnecessary [tax](https://substack.com/redirect/93574504-fa97-4655-a806-ff7da69fecce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on millions of people. Few, if any, shareholders vote to forgo returns to promote social or diversity objectives, yet that's exactly what's happening in boardrooms across the country.
[Business](https://substack.com/redirect/1f1c4ccf-cf6d-49a8-8e19-8a4f74cc16bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) leaders across corporate America have been adopting policies and practices that prioritize social concerns over shareholder returns. Think Bud Light or Target.
Boards form ESG committees with DEI mandates, and management directs employees to dedicate time, effort, and money to ensure the company has set, tracked, and met publicly declared goals. It's virtue signaling on steroids, and the side effects are lost profits, lower long-term shareholder returns, and a new form of diversity-driven socialism, all of which will eventually lead to higher prices for consumers.
Is it possible, then, to describe hiring initiatives that only make sense from a DEI perspective as anything other than a DEI tax on both shareholders and consumers? If a company hires the best people, regardless of skin color, gender, or religion, isn't that just good business? And if leaders prioritize a certain skin color or gender, wouldn't that be racism or sexism (not to mention illegal)? Every company in every industry should recruit from everywhere, including underrepresented communities, because that improves the chances of finding capable talent, which, ultimately, is good for shareholders.
Yet faith in the burgeoning new diversity religion is so strong that merely questioning it is now taboo. I once distributed Milton Friedman's 1970 article "The Social Responsibility of Business Is To Increase Its Profits" to colleagues and was later told doing so was divisive and unhelpful. Almost every time I question this new theology, I am subjected to mini lectures about historical inequities and the urgent need to address them. And despite being a first-generation American who grew up in a working-class household, I've been repeatedly told to check my privilege and acknowledge that I'm an oppressor.
Of course, this may be nothing more than a grift, a ruse used by some people to enrich themselves. Contracts are awarded to the very board members who champion these quotas, and if anyone highlights or questions such double-dealing conflicts of interest, he or she will likely be silenced, punished, and shown the door. There is no room for heresy.
But in the end, companies that embrace the DEI agenda suffer subpar profitability, have less tolerance for diversity of ideas (and a corresponding higher risk of unionization), and generate lower long-run returns for shareholders. These companies tend to be hotbeds of go-along-to-get-along governance that replaces profitability and total shareholder return with alternative metrics that provide political or financial benefit to those who champion them. Achieving social objectives is often now more important than meeting customer needs, lowering costs through process improvements, or maximizing shareholder value. Purpose, the new religion expounds, is a higher calling than profits. Welcome to today's version of stakeholder capitalism a la _Atlas Shrugged_.
It's worth acknowledging that DEI is a distorted reincarnation of failed communist ideologies. When faith in collectivism collapsed following the implosion of the Soviet Union, socialist leaders fled to academia and recruited climate alarmists and anti-racists as next-generation revolutionaries. The movement replaced worker exploitation with social ills as the motivating outrage to circumvent market forces, redirect resources, and silence critics.
Let me be clear. I am an unabashed capitalist and firmly believe the pursuit of profits drives creative destruction and innovation that has improved the lives of billions of people on this planet. This does not mean that social and diversity objectives are unworthy or unimportant. But if business leaders restore their focus on maximizing shareholder returns, they will enable the company's owners, in their individual capacities, to do what they wish with their profits. And over the long run, greater returns will enable greater social progress.
Too many companies today are focused on making social statements when they should be focused on making money. The sad reality is that these dynamics are more pervasive than people believe. As a result of passively ceding governance decisions to index funds and mutual fund managers committed to DEI, shareholders are being indirectly taxed and have no say in where the money goes.
This is taxation without representation, and it's time for a shareholder revolution -- one that holds boards accountable to the interests of the company's owners.
> _Vikram Mansharamani, a former lecturer at Harvard and Yale, has taught classes on business ethics and corporate governance. He served on the board of Werner Enterprises from 2021-2024. _

subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5e81906418f4680ac3f7e95f6aeea96&_e=DDPnUcYTCCO16J9qI7JTVLi0auuUHVES2dWqCxPM98TDJS6GqvgSHmJLNl0i3Qfk-hdp-vyq5wc6adLAlQzx7TJvosfsD82KbD11IFPdwWZFHNXpxUysi72koeYNtFXq2XKtyIGdCkc2El93eF3Isk-eKXVIys7st1SAU10w-7MHwX4k5ud7ZKJ7SLRa7nLe4N4zLgd490PP-_h_hJPmOTllvFY30i-i4R-5KOimaTt3vxe9WhIYRy3VpeZaMwy6Kzkqb5xn9WUZgFL5eP0vouw-G54actnYG-uvFVMZtHYXL3zZH3V-tHrc_44fOttlkkg9EOibO2rZmuFUVJMseRFSDZv507wURJ3YGsJSs3GbLBE8cYhvIzQo0OiX9zAChCyNpyKQaStvWqy5HIffTg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5e81906418f4680ac3f7e95f6aeea96&_e=DDPnUcYTCCO16J9qI7JTVLi0auuUHVES2dWqCxPM98TDJS6GqvgSHmJLNl0i3Qfk-hdp-vyq5wc6adLAlQzx7TJvosfsD82KbD11IFPdwWZFHNXpxUysi72koeYNtFXq2XKtyIGdCkc2El93eF3Isk-eKXVIys7st1SAU10w-7MHwX4k5ud7ZKJ7SLRa7nLe4N4zLgd490PP-_h_hJPmOTllvFY30i-i4R-5KOimaTt3vxe9WhIYRy3VpeZaMwy6fMHoy8cMW4RU_9OohPFdJRGQ5FLBfVglweKkjvTx3jqQIHiP_g1_cL1q3W3yBWoFjFXq0S_KWzZ9A8ciaT3gufdwdJmBmwRT_NHrqD26k04HGO5HOnfZ7uKBs2F31Hed-ymzaD6YAR31nLXd2zjoJA%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5e81906418f4680ac3f7e95f6aeea96&_e=DDPnUcYTCCO16J9qI7JTVLi0auuUHVES2dWqCxPM98TDJS6GqvgSHmJLNl0i3Qfk-hdp-vyq5wc6adLAlQzx7TJvosfsD82KbD11IFPdwWZFHNXpxUysi72koeYNtFXq2XKtyIGdCkc2El93eF3Isk-eKXVIys7st1SAU10w-7MHwX4k5ud7ZKJ7SLRa7nLe4N4zLgd490PP-_h_hJPmOTllvFY30i-i4R-5KOimaTt3vxe9WhIYRy3VpeZaMwy6LZvwX5BacIlEpaWzV_LGIXV6dfxLr3GeoB2CqvYN_F7YCXMYEEaUbOS2J3KpUCMdhIQX-4ezWC_W5nPFcwczsUZG_MwZmkg8_6GYpJkjrKr9QkBltyP8kgrZIfsADIMJgSuczYHmYF2mQ-hYkmtzrQ%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

_**In Case You Missed It...**_
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=36a22559f5&e=a20d8ad2ed)
**Widow of former Alaska Rep. Don Young endorses candidate to replace late husband**
April 11, 2024By Cami Mondeaux
_“The widow of former Alaska GOP Rep. Don Young is weighing in on the race to replace her late husband, giving crucial support to a Republican candidate seeking to flip the seat held by Rep. Mary Peltola (D-AK)._
_“**Anne Garland Young is endorsing Lt. Gov. Nancy Dahlstrom for Alaska’s sole House seat, the campaign first announced to the Washington Examiner. The endorsement is likely to give Dahlstrom a boost in one of the most competitive races of the 2024 cycle.**_
_“‘[Dahlstrom] is the only candidate my husband, Congressman Don Young would be supporting,’ Anne Young said in a statement. ‘She is an active, experienced, and competent leader in Alaska already, and I know that her integrity and proven representative skills will uniquely serve our state in Congress.’_
_“**Anne Young’s backing is the latest in a string of high-profile endorsements for Dahlstrom, who already has the support of top House Republicans** such as Speaker Mike Johnson (R-LA), Majority Leader Steve Scalise (R-LA), Majority Whip Tom Emmer (R-MN), and House Republican Conference Chairwoman Elise Stefanik (R-NY). Dahlstrom has also been endorsed by Gov. Mike Dunleavy (R-AK). _
_“‘It is an absolute honor to receive the trust and support of Anne. I stepped up to run this campaign because I saw our current representative failing to live up to the standard and legacy Congressman Young set,’ Dahlstrom said. ‘My promise to Alaska is that I will fight for our state with the same ferocity, passion, and conviction that Don Young did and I will never compromise Alaska’s needs and values.’_
_“‘Nancy is the person Alaska needs with the values Alaskans share,’ Anne Young said. ‘She will stand up for Alaska in every way, just as my husband did.’_
_“Dahlstrom is looking to unseat Peltola, who managed to flip the seat in Democrats’ favor in 2022 after defeating former Alaska Gov. Sarah Palin. Peltola’s win marked the first time Democrats flipped the seat in 50 years.”_
Read more [here](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=e067db405a&e=a20d8ad2ed).

He says he’s going to cut taxes for his rich friends, all while cutting Social Security, Medicare, and other vital programs for everyone else. subject: Are you tired?
body:
It doesn’t have to be this way
Dear Fellow American,

Are you tired of being told that everything is going fine in America today?

It's a big lie. It's a lie being told by Adam Schiff and Joe Biden (one of many) to stay in power. And it's a lie that good people like you are ALWAYS forced to pay the price for.

But it doesn't have to be that way.

Opening our borders is a **CHOICE**.

Siding with violent criminals over our brave police is a **CHOICE**.

Spending our country into an oblivion of debt and inflation is a **CHOICE**.

Allowing homelessness and addiction to render our streets and neighborhoods unsafe is a **CHOICE**.

Accepting failed public schools is a **CHOICE**.

And the ones making these "choices" for a combined 79 years in office?

_**That would be Adam Schiff and Joe Biden.**_

**Eight decades is enough.**

Here’s the deal, Fellow American.

I’m a straight shooter – always have been always will. You might not like what I have to say but I will _never_ sugarcoat the truth. _Trust me, we deal with that enough in Washington._

So, here’s the God-honest truth: \*\*Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team.\*\*

\*\*We’ll lose the House, and truly, I don’t think we can handle a single day of total Democrat control in Washington.\*\*

What Democrats want to do to America is clinically insane – _they want to change our foundations, to make our country unrecognizable. They are wasting all of your hard-earned money to fund illegal immigrants, higher prices, defunding the police, forcing parents out of the classroom, and lining their own pockets. _

You might be burnt out from the constant stream of news out of Washington, trust me I get it... but if you want things to actually change for the better, _ \*\*you have to pay attention.\*\* _

\*\*We can’t sit back and take this way of life because if we do we’ll see Democrats take our country away.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4755583.2082.1.3d65f24b741f7c4d85aa758ee62745d9 )

\*\*I need to know you’re on the team who still cares about freedom. _I need to know you are on the team who’s willing to stand up and FIGHT back against the woke mob that is infecting our country._\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4755583.2083.1.1138ebc8c9a1cac4c297ca7aec34f336 )

-> \*\* JOIN THE TEAM ➞ \*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4755583.2084.1.189889642ff1eb4d3be026e317bd884a )<-

Think back on your life four years ago – were things better for you under President Trump? _Under a strong Republican majority in the House and the Senate? _

I can tell you for sure that it used to cost less to fill up my car with gas and eggs were 49% cheaper. I can tell you that I used to feel safe walking down the street knowing that our border was closed and there were police to protect me under Republican leadership.

\*\*We have to work together if we’re going to save our country.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4755583.2085.1.afaf5e805c39e0c45c280944503c3861 )

\*\*Please help.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4755583.2088.1.d7c281c53183f0a7b4204cb71c8f6ee3 )

Gratefully,

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4755583.2089.1.4de3d556670c86ece66eec172d7f57a5 )

Nancy Mace

P.S. I know money is tight, but truly one dollar can make a difference in a campaign like mine because these races come down to the last minute and the last dollar. So, if you only have a dollar to spare, please know how thankful I am for your support, and I hope to continue to make you proud in Congress.

| | **First, the good news** :
Our campaign is funded by a record number of individual donations made by people from all backgrounds and from all communities — almost all of these donations coming from working people united in their desire for change. Meanwhile, poll after poll shows us leading against Kari Lake.
**Now, the bad news.** The average donation to our campaign has slipped from $40, to $30, now all the way down to $21 this month. It’s a refreshing change for people sick of the role money plays in politics, but we haven’t had the number of donations so far in March to reach our goals. Not great. So we have two options: First, either we need lots and lots of donations to help us reach our goals. Or, we need people to chip in just a bit more than they normally would. Normally we ask people who haven’t given to our Senate campaign to contribute $3.
But today, we need to ask you to do a bit more, if you can. Will you? For Ruben? For this race? For a good vote in the Senate for the next six years?
[**Can you please split $20 between Ruben Gallego’s campaign for Senate in Arizona and No Dem Left Behind? Our goals are not arbitrary, they are set to reach what we need to win this race.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndlb-az-split?refcode=ng&amount=20)

Friend, I don’t have to tell you how much I believe in fighting for the God-given freedoms our founding fathers fought so hard to secure for us.

I probably also don’t have to tell you that Democrats in Washington are working overtime to undermine the foundation of this great country. They are piling massive debts on our kids and grandkids. They have thrown our borders wide open. They are indoctrinating our school children. And, they are using the judicial system and federal bureaucracy to target conservatives who dare to oppose them.

You know the stakes could not be higher! At this critical time in our nation, I know we cannot afford to send even one more politician to Congress who is more concerned about climbing the next rung on the political ladder than in fighting for us.

We have a freedom fighter right here in Virginia who is on the front lines of the battle to save our country. Congressman Bob Good is standing up for our freedoms and our future every single day in Congress. Not only is he taking on Joe Biden and the Democrats, but he is not afraid to take on members of his own party when they are wrong.

Bob is not just saying the right things and voting the right way (though he does). Bob was chosen by the members of the House Freedom Caucus to be just the 5th Chairman of that elite caucus in Congress. He is following in the footsteps of Jim Jordan and Mark Meadows who founded the Freedom Caucus because they believed Republicans should actually do what they promised you they would do. And Virginia has the honor of having one of its own as the leader of those courageous warriors fighting the hardest to save our country.

That is why I am writing to you today. _I wanted to ask you to support my friend and true patriot Bob Good._

Peter, it’s Ritchie. My story is a bit different than most members of Congress, and I want to take a moment to tell you about it.

I grew up in public housing, raised by a single mother making minimum wage, which at the time was only $4.25 per hour. I won’t lie: it was difficult.

**But today I understand the struggles of New York families because I lived them myself, Peter.**

When it comes to poverty or inequality, food insecurity or housing, mental health or LGBTQ+ rights, I don’t _just_ think about policy — I think about my own lived experiences. **Because for me, policy _is_ personal. It always has been.**

And it’s these lived experiences that motivate me every single time I walk into my office in D.C.

They drive me to fight to end child poverty.
They drive me to push for better LGBTQ+ protections.
They drive me to ensure fair, affordable housing for all.
They drive me to put money in the pockets of working families.

[**Peter, it’s not just policy, it’s _personal_ — and I refuse to give up. This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eBdUgppKVvI7Yf2PdzsZbA~~/AARclAA~/RgRn__SyP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNDE1VwNzcGNCCmYQCVodZlWqYetSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eBdUgppKVvI7Yf2PdzsZbA~~/AARclAA~/RgRn__SyP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNDE1VwNzcGNCCmYQCVodZlWqYetSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eBdUgppKVvI7Yf2PdzsZbA~~/AARclAA~/RgRn__SyP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNDE1VwNzcGNCCmYQCVodZlWqYetSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| | | **Take Action This Tax Season: **
**Help Reduce Our Tax Burden**
---

Dear Peter,
Here on the April 15th tax deadline, many of us in Washington’s 8th district feel the weight of our tax responsibilities. It’s a stark reminder of the pressing need to reform our tax system and lessen the burden on everyday citizens like you.

Carmen Goers is committed to advocating for tax policies that not only simplify our tax code but also significantly reduce the financial load on our district’s hardworking families and small businesses. Her campaign is driven by the belief that everyone deserves to keep more of their hard-earned money.

This tax season, we have a chance to support a leader who will fight for us. By donating to Carmen’s campaign, you’re endorsing a vision for lower and fairer taxes. Your contribution will directly empower Carmen to challenge the status quo and ensure that our voices are heard.

| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=16760fa4c2ac447db96d5baf9e891d4a&_e=9o8DB79thyE98Em3Fq0cu9tS7ZjL2tcn5T2mgV8dtB_6ioO3iaLa320BavRgORNkkgDYhc-Ezv9uvEz_2FVZwL233bAXjcQ2IGQT-gcdPq3jgRD5UFUumXL5nghfzNzwnFtPGOufY8EOEyETjBbZwomPDe91mCXEK6i4bpRbqniEWTUD6lckwgn8uGobP_Fwpx1fer0_aysdOJWFi6A9R6lIwfsWDrVxhLpbQXVb2qt7xEp4NeKPEYbEfapa5Tn_Dc2U3DlUbLPmggxB3U5tPu16xpAakQKkt-aYPQZSKHaPxqWsuWwA1hWYQHWgymq36Rv9v-pon9Lfg7n8FS-CwnieaxpttpR-bzppRl8RINbg1N-lyhk7T5PlC6jW26wTekpzG7_Gv3rdtyasPVjhtg%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=16760fa4c2ac447db96d5baf9e891d4a&_e=9o8DB79thyE98Em3Fq0cu9tS7ZjL2tcn5T2mgV8dtB_6ioO3iaLa320BavRgORNkkgDYhc-Ezv9uvEz_2FVZwL233bAXjcQ2IGQT-gcdPq3jgRD5UFUumXL5nghfzNzwnFtPGOufY8EOEyETjBbZwomPDe91mCXEK6i4bpRbqniEWTUD6lckwgn8uGobP_Fwpx1fer0_aysdOJWFi6A9R6lIwfsWDrVxhLpbQXVb2qt7xEp4NeKPEYbEfapa5Tn_Jt7tFT-I1LoOgJk_FItPIZTF8vsXBYiAlGCQWDI-kvIuLYVEwAtGSZZWCjjqH4528hP35rpCnRBB2KCe_8_jnYlu2ftG7x4Uc2-4bgh5LJieqFAq6PxTP4gSJ4QhaL2PY3sstntWRJdPljVZ5zPaQw%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

If you believe that American children deserve to receive the best education possible, [can I personally ask you to help me accomplish my goal of getting this first-of-its-kind curriculum to anyone who needs it?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=16760fa4c2ac447db96d5baf9e891d4a&_e=9o8DB79thyE98Em3Fq0cu9tS7ZjL2tcn5T2mgV8dtB_6ioO3iaLa320BavRgORNkkgDYhc-Ezv9uvEz_2FVZwL233bAXjcQ2IGQT-gcdPq3jgRD5UFUumXL5nghfzNzwnFtPGOufY8EOEyETjBbZwomPDe91mCXEK6i4bpRbqniEWTUD6lckwgn8uGobP_Fwpx1fer0_aysdOJWFi6A9R6lIwfsWDrVxhLpbQXVb2qt7xEp4NeKPEYbEfapa5Tn_GpntMdLwZhjR6SPy37Ti2TQ1g0UX3P5ItYCmEjWeJenOlUn3048lBXHUz771uDi3s6Gc7EpDu0bArY6J3EmkHcgY7kvJbvVaSRL0lARryZP1XgtfdLBhugGysROirJtKhPYgrBEYIddeSQ96JUw6Jw%3D%3D)

If you'd like to help me get Little Patriots to more American children, please click the link below to make your generous tax-deductible gift today:

[**https://secure.americancornerstone.org/little-patriots-tour-donate**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=16760fa4c2ac447db96d5baf9e891d4a&_e=9o8DB79thyE98Em3Fq0cu9tS7ZjL2tcn5T2mgV8dtB_6ioO3iaLa320BavRgORNkkgDYhc-Ezv9uvEz_2FVZwL233bAXjcQ2IGQT-gcdPq3jgRD5UFUumXL5nghfzNzwnFtPGOufY8EOEyETjBbZwomPDe91mCXEK6i4bpRbqniEWTUD6lckwgn8uGobP_Fwpx1fer0_aysdOJWFi6A9R6lIwfsWDrVxhLpbQXVb2qt7xEp4NeKPEYbEfapa5Tn_y7eJAjbtEe8pW5IrADeoSq5tBkIFnz7tE1-o3yHhnsQK1rEmgACRlfwiiI7Pm2ZwNe463rY-15JXfMVam9iakU5-dECg-AMraJvV-mWGQP5haVh8AV1H8wHCUg7XIZlPdJEKoXfZ841HsvZ5wqy8tA%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for supporting these efforts--[together we can help kids across the U.S. get the education they deserve.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=16760fa4c2ac447db96d5baf9e891d4a&_e=9o8DB79thyE98Em3Fq0cu9tS7ZjL2tcn5T2mgV8dtB_6ioO3iaLa320BavRgORNkkgDYhc-Ezv9uvEz_2FVZwL233bAXjcQ2IGQT-gcdPq3jgRD5UFUumXL5nghfzNzwnFtPGOufY8EOEyETjBbZwomPDe91mCXEK6i4bpRbqniEWTUD6lckwgn8uGobP_Fwpx1fer0_aysdOJWFi6A9R6lIwfsWDrVxhLpbQXVb2qt7xEp4NeKPEYbEfapa5Tn_6lIsVn42hd6-oeTppmbm7rR2dUeNZqBP379k9oF6yhLqcSGNQ4qN85kkFFYSM3fyTRUQkHYMZxfw-5RYGQ_OkDQ3WFIqSkZmCjBDuAaUYsHVNYpT_1JAvlbf0jpmg1xVIIeBdTnkT0N-UYCwlCullQ%3D%3D)

But progress has stalled out, straining health care systems and hindering access to vital treatment and emergency services. **The toll of these drugs on lives, families, and communities cannot be overstated. We must reinvigorate efforts to combat the opioid epidemic and save lives.** We must staunch the flow of lethal opioids into our communities and bolster support for recovery efforts. Here’s what Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fighting for free and fair elections

On Friday, Donald Trump and U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson doubled down
on baseless claims of rampant voter fraud, announcing a legislative
proposal that would lead to widespread voter suppression across the
country.

The proposed legislation — based on the false claim that Democrats are
registering droves of noncitizens to vote — would require Americans to
prove their citizenship in order to register and force states to remove
suspected noncitizens from the rolls.

This would effectively disenfranchise millions of Americans. When Texas
tried this in the past, they flagged nearly 100,000 people for removal
from the voter registration rolls — but the courts later found that the
voters they targeted were indeed eligible citizens.

This latest attack on the right to vote reminds us how important it is for
us to stop Trump and elect a pro-democracy majority to Congress this year.
If we don’t put in the work to win these races, this may be the last free
and fair election we ever have.

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b51eefb5149349da9759d2b12525544c&_e=w9Wi1aFDz47XKk3wipmbCrMcJIAZsmSCi2xFL9EClcc25PRz-EgSdNNbBwEWSZK9puVI8b-b0ylsNGqXYt20Qii_Ctk72Sa4xcboafcng9GKYoXMU17LLHiNimYkWMrq8_4lT9u90urGR8u-hVUcQ8eloyfoz8M8oTm4iBmyfZQN1nFTBRL60Qh3lS5oTYvmHKHhUVopyYJqDA3QJW7Ue0H2dhuoZnXJJhJt4nmXG_MiOgJPq_pH9K1guJVizQcAGtRRGFpPMeSxB5L1MUOu3g-JNcxxQnBVyTFHsHpA30YwE6nx0UXQbKXnZiCYoMXReVcw9CiG9X-Rx9Y4vNdwKi9CWZKcQya-psDhMFHOGU0NY1FMZdLoK39EcMIyMr7yagAiY0L8GXV1dBa04sD0MifuQBJbWTgyDRKoJ_y4dQQ%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

As draconian laws about women’s bodies continue to be written by rooms full of men, the stakes for women are higher than they’ve been in decades. We are living in a critical time to elect women to the rooms where decisions are being made.

According to the Center for American Women and Politics:

❌ Men account for 73% of elected U.S. leaders and representatives, and that number has not really moved in four years. These are the people passing abortion bans across the country.

❌ Women only account for 24% of candidates for the U.S. House of Representatives, 18.3% of U.S. Senate candidates, and 21.7% of candidates for Governor.

❌ The number of women candidates running for the U.S. House is down by 21.6% since 2022.

❌ 14 congresswomen have announced that they are not running for re-election to their current seats in Congress. Nine congresswomen have announced their retirements from Congress with no intention of running for other public offices.

**This means that the U.S. is very likely to have fewer women in office next year than we have today, which would reverse all of the important progress we’ve made since 2018 – unless we do something to stop this trend.**

| | It’s Tax Day, and while people don't usually connect taxes with voting rights, they were once used as a form of voter suppression. After the 15th Amendment extended the freedom to vote to Black men, Black voters in Georgia and across the South were still denied the right to vote for nearly a century. Discriminatory methods like poll taxes, literacy tests, and violent threats were used if they attempted to vote. A poll tax, which required voters to pay a fee in order to cast their ballots, removed Black Americans from the democratic process and silenced their voices. The use of poll taxes in national elections was abolished by the 24th Amendment, but the Voting Rights Act of 1965 led to the end of poll taxes in state and local elections. **Modern-day anti-voting lawmakers are still trying to make it harder for Black and brown communities to vote, which means we have to keep fighting back.[Let’s keep forms of voter suppression in the past where they belong — your gift today will make a real difference to protect the freedom to vote.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83076275/467221156/-2133028407?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20240415_f_taxday_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Zjc5OTczYy01NGZiLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2lUabyhH2KjgFrzLXLqv_pFE-Sl8Q_hphxZhIE07r7w=)** Thank you for your support. | | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don't think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

* "[C]lose allies [of Donald Trump] want to dramatically change the government's interpretation of Civil Rights-era laws to focus on ‘anti-white racism’ rather than discrimination against people of color.”

body:
In Congress, I will fight to enshrine the right to abortion under federal law.
#
Last week, when we learned that the Arizona Supreme Court had revived an 1864 law effectively banning abortions in the state of Arizona, **I was outraged.** I’m sure you were, too.
This decision, which will lead to a _near-total ban on all abortion care_ , is yet another outrageous example of right-wing extremists rolling back women’s rights.
In Congress, I will fight to enshrine the right to an abortion under federal law. **But I need your help to win this race so I can take our fight to Washington.**
[**Can you pitch in $5 now to help us close the books on our mid-month fundraising goal before the midnight deadline? Every dollar makes a difference.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240415?refcode=em20240415-1-48&amount=5&refcode2=48_21716_UpATQa&akid=48%2E21716%2EUpATQa)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240415?amount=5&refcode=em20240415-1-48&refcode2=48_21716_UpATQa&akid=48%2E21716%2EUpATQa)**
We always knew that the anti-abortion extremists would not be satisfied with the far-right Supreme Court’s reversal of _Roe v. Wade_. They are working in states across the country to strip access to care, targeting abortion medications and even fertility treatments. And we know that they won’t stop at the state level. They will try to ban abortion nationwide. No state — no matter how blue — will be safe.
That’s why it’s so important that we send a pro-choice Democratic majority to the House this November — because the MAGA GOP cannot be trusted with our reproductive freedom.
[**I’m ready to take this fight to Congress and make the right to abortion the law of the land, but I can’t win this race alone. We’ve got a midnight deadline — will you donate $5 or any amount that makes sense before our window closes?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240415?refcode=em20240415-1-48&amount=5&refcode2=48_21716_UpATQa&akid=48%2E21716%2EUpATQa)

This decision, which will lead to a near-total ban on all abortion care , is yet another outrageous example of right-wing extremists rolling back women’s rights. In Congress, I will fight to enshrine the right to an abortion under federal law. But I need your help to win this race so I can take our fight to Washington. We always knew that the anti-abortion extremists would not be satisfied with the far-right Supreme Court’s reversal of Roe v. Wade. They are working in states across the country to strip access to care, targeting abortion medications and even fertility treatments. And we know that they won’t stop at the state level. They will try to ban abortion nationwide. No state — no matter how blue — will be safe. That’s why it’s so important that we send a pro-choice Democratic majority to the House this November — because the MAGA GOP cannot be trusted with our reproductive freedom. With gratitude, Sarah McBride

**This is our Oz/McCormick Moment.**

_P.S. Now is the time. Please forward this to every Democrat you know in the 10th District. It's how we win._

You may have seen the stories about fundraising in our 10th Congressional race to replace insurrectionist Scott Perry. They document that one of my opponents, who still doesn’t have a permanent residence here, has raised most of his money from out-of-state donors. The other without any residence here has raised most of her money from PA residents, but apparently not from 10th District residents.

**This begs the question: Is this really what we want when choosing our candidate? Outside money funding outside people?**

I have focused my campaign on the working class, not the donor class. I have spent my time knocking on doors and _listening_ to what our people and communities need from their representative in Congress.

Don’t get me wrong. The donor class is important. At a time when every Congressional seat has national significance, the donor class of both Democrats and Republicans is essential to victory. But in a _primary_ election, I think it is primarily important to have the support of local people and the knowledge that only comes from living among you and listening to you.

In this campaign, I have done the unheard-of by urging voters to visit my opponents’ websites and compare our experience, our knowledge of the issues, and our record of service to the nation and the communities where we live. I believe that _informed_ voters will choose me to represent them.

I also believe that persistence is an essential quality for a member of Congress. If I don’t succeed, I try, try again.

Name recognition can be bought, and there’s plenty of time between April and November to buy it. But the qualifications and experience to serve the 10th District in Congress can’t be bought. They have to be earned. I have earned them and continue to earn your trust.

Right now, what I need most is your vote. After that, everything else will fall in line.

Respectfully,

Rick

clean_body: | This is our Oz/McCormick Moment. P.S. Now is the time. Please forward this to every Democrat you know in the 10th District. It's how we win. You may have seen the stories about fundraising in our 10th Congressional race to replace insurrectionist Scott Perry. They document that one of my opponents, who still doesn’t have a permanent residence here, has raised most of his money from out-of-state donors. The other without any residence here has raised most of her money from PA residents, but apparently not from 10th District residents. This begs the question: Is this really what we want when choosing our candidate? Outside money funding outside people? I have focused my campaign on the working class, not the donor class. I have spent my time knocking on doors and listening to what our people and communities need from their representative in Congress. Don’t get me wrong. The donor class is important. At a time when every Congressional seat has national significance, the donor class of both Democrats and Republicans is essential to victory. But in a primary election, I think it is primarily important to have the support of local people and the knowledge that only comes from living among you and listening to you. In this campaign, I have done the unheard-of by urging voters to visit my opponents’ websites and compare our experience, our knowledge of the issues, and our record of service to the nation and the communities where we live. I believe that informed voters will choose me to represent them. I also believe that persistence is an essential quality for a member of Congress. If I don’t succeed, I try, try again. Name recognition can be bought, and there’s plenty of time between April and November to buy it. But the qualifications and experience to serve the 10th District in Congress can’t be bought. They have to be earned. I have earned them and continue to earn your trust. Right now, what I need most is your vote. After that, everything else will fall in line. Respectfully, Rick | | = | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen | =
