name: Team Lucas Kunce
subject: The fight to protect reproductive freedom runs straight through Missouri
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
and Missourians are ready to fight back.
#
On June 24, 2022, the U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade.
On June 24, 2022 – just moments after that decision – control-obsessed politicians immediately signed into law a dormant trigger ban, making their state the first in the nation to enact a near-total ban on abortion.
Which state was that? You guessed it:
**Missouri.**
Today, Missouri’s draconian abortion ban, which has no exceptions for rape or incest, remains in place – despite lacking popular support from Missourians across the political spectrum. Recent polling shows that _less than eleven percent_ of Missourians believe that abortion should be completely illegal.
That’s why thousands of everyday Missourians have been working together to get reproductive rights on the ballot this year. And that’s also why politicians in the Missouri state legislature are working frantically to restrict democracy in the state: **because they are afraid.**
They know that, when reproductive rights are on the ballot, people will vote time and time again to take back their power — just like we’ve seen in red states like Kansas, Kentucky, and Ohio. And they’re terrified of letting everyday Missourians take back the freedom to control their own bodies, families, and lives.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45595?refcode=em20240415-5280&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5280%2E614464%2Eogxntf)
Missourians are fired up and ready to fight back. And they’re not stopping at the statewide level. They’re also ready to elect Lucas Kunce, a proven warrior for working people, who will fight to protect reproductive rights in the U.S. Senate.
They’re ready to fire Josh Hawley, whose repeated attacks on reproductive freedom, in the interest of his family’s personal and business agendas, have proven he won’t be satisfied until he has completely dismantled reproductive rights for every person in the country piece-by-piece.
[(Read more about Hawley’s corruption and attacks on abortion here.)](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45551?t=2&akid=5280%2E614464%2Eogxntf)
Reproductive rights aren’t just on the line for people in some states this year – they’re on the line for people in every state. _And Missouri is on the frontlines of that fight._
Folks in Missouri are fighting back now, and they’re ready to fight back at the ballot box in November.
But we can’t do it alone, and we hope you’ll help support us in this fight.
-Team Lucas Kunce

clean_body: We’ve added a brand new installment to the Democratic Trailblazers collection! | | Team -- Today, we’re excited to share with you that we’ve added brand new products to the Democratic Trailblazers collection featuring Congressman John Lewis. It’s impossible to summarize Congressman Lewis’s legacy, but here are some of the ways he blazed trails for our Party and this country: He championed civil rights as chairman of the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee (which he helped found on this day in 1960!). He led the March on Selma , bravely crossing the Edmund Pettus Bridge on Bloody Sunday. He served as a U.S. representative for more than 30 years, earning himself the nickname “the conscience of Congress.” Your purchase supports the next generation of trailblazing Democrats up and down the ballot fighting to protect and build upon John Lewis’s legacy. body:
Here’s who I’m supporting
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF)
Hey Derek, I wanted to make sure you saw my earlier email announcing Truth to Power’s first endorsements of the 2024 election cycle.
These three California Democrats are running in our state’s most competitive, must-win races—and the House majority is on the line. **[Can you rush a donation?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240415-endorsements?refcode=em20240415-38825&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38825_3422442_gAEllF&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF)**
* * *
Derek, today I’m excited to announce Truth to Power’s first official endorsements of the 2024 election cycle.
Dave Min, Derek Tran, and Will Rollins are California Democrats running in key House districts. All three are rejecting corporate PAC money, so anything you give makes a real difference. **[Can you make a donation right now that will be split between these three campaigns and Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240415-endorsements?refcode=em20240415-38825&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38825_3422442_gAEllF&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240415-endorsements?refcode=em20240415-38825&refcode2=38825_3422442_gAEllF&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF)
**Dave Min** is running in CA-47, the Orange County district I currently represent in Congress. I gave up this seat when I ran for the U.S. Senate, and I have confidence this seat will continue to be represented by a progressive Democrat for years to come. But winning in this district takes real work and serious resources, which is why Dave could use your support to defeat the same MAGA extremist opponent this team helped me defeat in 2022.
**Derek Tran** is running in CA-45, another Orange County district—this one represented by a Republican. Derek is an Army veteran, workers' rights attorney, City Commissioner, father of three young kids, and son of refugees. With enough grassroots support, we can flip this district back to blue and help deliver a Democratic majority.
**Will Rollins** is running in CA-41, a district that includes Palm Springs. As a former federal prosecutor who focused on counterterrorism and counterintelligence, he helped prosecute some of the insurrectionists who attacked the Capitol on January 6th. Will ran in 2022 and got *so* close to flipping this district blue, he just needs our help to get the job done in November.
California is key to the House majority, but with some of the most expensive media markets in the country, these candidates are counting on us to help them run ads, knock doors, and reach key voters. Can you give today?
**[Yes, I’ll give $16.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240415-endorsements?refcode=em20240415-38825&amounts=16&refcode2=38825_3422442_gAEllF&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF)**
**[Yes, I’ll give another amount.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240415-endorsements?refcode=em20240415-38825&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38825_3422442_gAEllF&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF)**
Thanks for reading,
Katie Porter

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240415-38825&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38825_3422442_gAEllF&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF)**
---

But, if you'd like to receive fewer emails, [**you can do so here**](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/receive-fewer-ttp-emails/). If you need to remove yourself from our email list, [click here to unsubscribe](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/ttp-unsubscribe/?t=3&akid=38825%2E3422442%2EgAEllF).

body:
We are in the final sprint before the May Primary, and we continue to make major strides in this race. Open this email to catch up the last week!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

As we dive deeper into the heart of campaign season, it's important to pause and reflect on the remarkable moments we've had in the past week. I️ released a new TV ad, had two crucial interviews that gave Hoosiers the opportunity to know me better, traveled the state from top to bottom, and went to three Lincoln Day Dinners!

Let's hit the highlights!

** VOLUNTEER CALLOUT: Join Team Crouch at the polls!
------------------------------------------------------------

We're gearing up for May 7, and we need your help! Join Team Crouch on Election Day by volunteering your time to support our campaign efforts. Whether you join us at the polls or assist in distributing yard signs, your involvement will make a significant impact.
Work the Polls with Team Crouch (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd9Z6yLZ7jQ6tr9Ii8N4YhK5Ny80U2CwXfGwmg3CtbDhHrFRw/viewform?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Distribute Signs on Election Day (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdKMgQORmL8woOQN4gGy6S9BB1LHIGy95MUaBHXnfPGbekVBA/viewform?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** 🚨 NEW TV AD ALERT 🚨: I️ just released a new TV ad titled: (https://vimeo.com/933522423?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) "We Fight for Them" (https://vimeo.com/933522423?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

When the FSSA made its disastrous $1 billion blunder and tried to solve it with healthcare cuts for severely disabled children, I stood up. I fought. I will NEVER stand idly by when Indiana's most vulnerable are at risk.
https://vimeo.com/933522423?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
WATCH (https://vimeo.com/933522423?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** ICYMI: You can vote in the May Primary today!
------------------------------------------------------------

Early in-person voting opened for the May Primary on Tuesday, April 9!

All registered Indiana voters (https://indianavoters.in.gov/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) are eligible to vote early. Contact your county clerk’s office to find out where and when you can cast your ballot early (https://indianavoters.in.gov/CountyContact/Index?utm_source=indianavoters&utm_medium=.in.gov&utm_campaign&utm_content=ap_n4gserjumn&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .
https://indianavoters.in.gov/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Find your voting location (https://indianavoters.in.gov/CountyContact/Index?utm_source=indianavoters&utm_medium=.in.gov&utm_campaign&utm_content=ap_n4gserjumn&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Who's on the ballot + other election information (https://indianavoters.in.gov/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN THE NEWS: In governor run, Lt. Gov. Crouch hopes voters will choose experience over politics (https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/04/10/suzanne-crouch-may-be-the-most-qualified-for-governor-will-it-matter/73055776007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

As we enter the final stretch of this race, let's focus on substance over soundbites and experience over rhetoric.

Thanks to Kayla Dwyer of the Indianapolis Star for taking the time to get to know me and showcase how my experience and dedication to Hoosiers set me apart.
https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/04/10/suzanne-crouch-may-be-the-most-qualified-for-governor-will-it-matter/73055776007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ARTICLE (https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/04/10/suzanne-crouch-may-be-the-most-qualified-for-governor-will-it-matter/73055776007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN THE NEWS: Indiana Can Cut Taxes Without Revenue Loss (https://crouchforindiana.com/crouch-indiana-can-cut-taxes-without-revenue-loss/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Indiana's economic progress has been hindered by our state's paternalistic top-down decision-making.

Check out my interview with Tony Katz on 93.1 WIBC where I share my vision for Indiana's tax policy. 👇
https://crouchforindiana.com/crouch-indiana-can-cut-taxes-without-revenue-loss/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ARTICLE + VIDEO TO WATCH (https://crouchforindiana.com/crouch-indiana-can-cut-taxes-without-revenue-loss/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** A Day in Martinsville
------------------------------------------------------------

Tuesday was a day dedicated to connecting with Hoosiers in Martinsville and visiting local agencies and officials who are making an impact in the area.

Some stops included visiting the Martinsville Rotary Club and touring Churches in Mission, which serves meals to thousands of Morgan County families and provides them with essential services.

I️ also visited Stability First, a nonprofit that aims to address poverty, homelessness and addiction in Martinsville and Morgan County.

In the afternoon, I️ had the pleasure of sitting down with local law enforcement to talk over a cup of coffee. I will always back the blue and support our law enforcement!

** Clark, Elkhart, and Lake County Lincoln Day Dinners
------------------------------------------------------------

Last week, I️ had the pleasure of attending three Lincoln Day Dinners: The first in Clark County on Wednesday, followed by another in Elkhart County on Friday, and Lake County on Saturday.

These events are a true celebration of our conservative values and showcase the strength of our party during this critical election year!

A heartfelt thank you to the local Republican Parties and their Chairs, Ron Grooms, Dan Holtz and Randy Niemeyer for organizing these memorable events!

** Women for Crouch - Evansville
------------------------------------------------------------

Thursday night's Women for Crouch event in Evansville was an absolute hit!

With another event scheduled for April 17th in Westfield, I am continually energized by the passion and dedication of our Republican women! Together, we WILL make history!

** Grant County GOP Brunch
------------------------------------------------------------

Saturday morning kicked off with insightful discussions and updates at the Grant County GOP Brunch. It was a pleasure to connect with supporters and discuss the vital projects shaping Grant County's future.

Special thanks to Chairman Darren Reese for organizing such a wonderful event!

** Munster GOP Candidate Forum
------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you to the Munster GOP for a productive forum Saturday. I️ always appreciate the opportunity to share my vision for Indiana and how I️ will always put Hoosiers first! That means fighting to eliminate the state income tax, defending our land, and prioritizing mental health.

** SUPPORTER SPOTLIGHT: Team Crouch at the Ripley County Lincoln Day Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------

Team Crouch was spotted at last week's Ripley County Lincoln Day Dinner!

Thanks for showing your support!

** ICYMI: Endorsements (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
Suzanne Crouch is the only gubernatorial candidate who has been endorsed by more than 160 past and present elected officials in Indiana. A full list of those endorsements can be found here. (https://crouchforindiana.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db6332b918877c0167cdddb48&id=b5bfcd6fae&e=1a234020cb&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

It's a privilege to be endorsed by Cathie Humbarger, whose work protecting the unborn and at-risk mothers has made a profound impact in Indiana.

Read more about why she supports my candidacy by following along with the images below. Thank you for standing with me, Cathie!

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------
We are in the final sprint before the May Primary, and we continue to make major strides in this race.

With all of the challenges Indiana and our country currently face, the stakes in this election couldn't be any higher. Your support is needed now more than ever. Get involved (https://crouchforindiana.com/get-involved/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6153139bb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_12_05_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6153139bb5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , get out and vote and show your support on social media.

With your help, we can and we will make history.

Onward and upward,

Let's keep the conversation going! Follow me on social to keep up with the campaign. Have questions, comments or concerns? Send me an email!

Check out my interview with Tony Katz on 93.1 WIBC where I share my vision for Indiana's tax policy. 👇 ARTICLE + VIDEO TO WATCH () A Day in Martinsville Tuesday was a day dedicated to connecting with Hoosiers in Martinsville and visiting local agencies and officials who are making an impact in the area. Some stops included visiting the Martinsville Rotary Club and touring Churches in Mission, which serves meals to thousands of Morgan County families and provides them with essential services. I️ also visited Stability First, a nonprofit that aims to address poverty, homelessness and addiction in Martinsville and Morgan County. In the afternoon, I️ had the pleasure of sitting down with local law enforcement to talk over a cup of coffee. I will always back the blue and support our law enforcement! A heartfelt thank you to the local Republican Parties and their Chairs, Ron Grooms, Dan Holtz and Randy Niemeyer for organizing these memorable events! With another event scheduled for April 17th in Westfield, I am continually energized by the passion and dedication of our Republican women! Together, we WILL make history! It was a pleasure to connect with supporters and discuss the vital projects shaping Grant County's future. Special thanks to Chairman Darren Reese for organizing such a wonderful event! Munster GOP Candidate Forum Thank you to the Munster GOP for a productive forum Saturday. I️ always appreciate the opportunity to share my vision for Indiana and how I️ will always put Hoosiers first! That means fighting to eliminate the state income tax, defending our land, and prioritizing mental health. **Dear Readers,**

This month has been filled with ups and downs.

As many of you heard, Solomon’s dad, Solomon Yue, Sr., passed away peacefully a couple weeks ago at age 94. Solomon and his brother, Daniel, had been doing all the hospice care themselves, so their dad was able to transition as he wished - home in his own bed.
This man was responsible at least twice that I know of for saving Solomon’s life - the last time was when the CCP told him if his son spoke out once more, they were going to make him disappear in the night, and he was going to be billed for the bullet. That moment began the family’s scramble to get Solomon to the U.S., but it would be several years and a lot of paperwork before Solomon was able to get his brother and parents here with him.
Solomon Sr. was a devout Christian, and he told Solomon just weeks ago that no matter what, keep fighting to save America. He knew what the inside of a Chinese jail cell looked like, and the miracle of being released on someone’s whim when he refused to confess whatever it was they wanted to hear. He lived through the CCP moving complete strangers into a home his family owned, through people he knew disappearing and his son getting sent to (and escaping from) a reeducation farm. These men saw the real face of communism. He had an amazing life and is with Jesus now.
I posted much of this on social media, and thanks to shares from Harmeet Dhillon and Tyler from Turning Point Action, over 40,000 people have been able to hear at least a little about Solomon Sr.'s life.

**FLORIDA.** Two days before his death, Vivien and I returned from West Palm Beach and Mar-a-Lago. The trip was bittersweet because originally Solomon had planned to go. He made an executive decision to send us on ahead to take care of business while he cared for his dad. We have Kari to thank for the invitation. Vivien was excited to see President Trump again - but the celebrity guests? Not so much! She's 12 and it was all about the lizards. Florida is full of them!

When I thought about running for Governor I thought about my oldest daughter, a junior at Western Washington University, and whether she would be able to afford to stay and live in the area where my wife and I grew up. I’m running because we need a governor who will prioritize keeping our state affordable for Washington families and be a better financial partner to cities and counties. I’ve heard loud and clear from the community that the cost of living is too much. I’m a business owner and the bottom line is how to get creative with what you have, come up with solutions to make it work. body:
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1165%2E62735%2EUe6aKy)
Peter, we know we’ve asked for your support a lot lately.
And with hours to go until our campaign’s mid-month fundraising deadline, **[we are humbly asking again that you chip in to help us grow Hill’s grassroots momentum. The primary is only _3 and a half months away,_ after all!](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1282?t=2&akid=1165%2E62735%2EUe6aKy)**
Every dollar you’ve contributed this far has helped us expand our dedicated field team, meet more Michigan voters where they’re at, and grow our people-powered movement into a winning campaign.
Thank you for supporting Hill’s fight.
But we need to be frank with you: The road ahead won’t be easy. While Hill is all-in on the fight for things like universal healthcare and getting dark money out of politics, he’s a first-time candidate running against the establishment. That means our opponents (on both sides of the aisle) are better-connected and better-funded.
That’s okay — we expected we’d be out-fundraised. But that’s also why we mean it when we say: _we can’t do this without grassroots support._ Hill’s not taking a dime from corporate PACs or special interest groups on his way to the Senate!
**It’s not the easy way, but it’s the _right_ way. It’s going to take a movement of people like you, Peter, chipping in here and there to elect Hill to the Senate and put Washington back to work for the people.**
**[So, with tonight’s deadline rapidly approaching, we're asking if you can make a contribution ASAP. Whether it's $5, $10, or more, every bit will help us close the gap and fuel Hill’s fight in the weeks leading up to the primary.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1304?t=3&akid=1165%2E62735%2EUe6aKy)**

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Team, there’s been a LOT in the news lately about abortion access.
Most of it, of course, is horrific and frustrating (see: Arizona going back to a near-total 1864 ban that was in place before women could vote, and before Arizona was even a state).
Some of it is slightly confusing (see: Florida simultaneously approving a 6-week ban and putting an abortion access ballot measure on the November ticket).
And some of it is just plain ridiculous (see: Donald Trump claiming he won’t sign a federal abortion ban if he’s elected).
Here’s why that’s ridiculous: We know for a fact that Donald Trump will say or do whatever benefits him at any moment, true or not. We also know that Trump appointed three extreme Supreme Court justices who ultimately made the majority of the majority that overturned Roe v. Wade . And we all heard Trump brag about the end of Roe v. Wade as a “miracle.”
So where is this latest supposed “pivot” coming from?
Well, he already told us:
In January, during a GOP presidential primary debate on Fox News, Trump acknowledged how unpopular abortion bans are and how badly they are impacting Republicans’ chances at the ballot box. He said, “We’re going to come up with something that people want and people like...You’ve got to win elections.”
There it is.
I’m not going to waste a single second thinking that Trump is on the side of women here – or on the side of the majority of Americans who want abortion to be accessible. Trump is on one side, and one side only: his own.
For every pregnant person whose life is at risk after the loss of Roe , for every young person scared to grow up in this reality, and for everyone who has lost rights in our country, we need to defeat Trump and every single one of his acolytes this November.
I’m running against an extreme anti-abortion MAGA Republican, and there are candidates just like him running in key races up and down the ticket all across the country. If we want to send a clear message that they can’t win with these ridiculous anti-choice policies, we need to take action now .
Will you pitch in any amount to my re-election campaign to help secure a big victory against my MAGA opponent? You can make a secure online contribution at this link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em
Thank you so much for your support. There’s no going quietly when it comes to our bodies and our freedoms.
-Sara

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Appalling
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
My granddaughter is growing up with fewer rights and protections than my grandmother had. That’s just not how things are supposed to go in the United States.
#

Hey there friend, it's Mark Kelly.
I’m proud to live in Arizona. I’m proud that my daughter and my granddaughter call Arizona home. I’m proud of everything we’ve accomplished here.
Serving as Arizona’s Senator is one of the greatest honors of my life.
But I can’t hide that I am absolutely appalled that the state I call home is about to have a law reinstated that was originally passed in 1864 to ban abortion.
It’s almost too ridiculous to believe — a law passed before any of us were born, before Arizona was a state, before the Union had won the Civil War, and long before women earned the right to vote.
My granddaughter is growing up with fewer rights and protections than my grandmother had. That’s just not how things are supposed to go in the United States.
Alongside our work to hold the White House, win more seats in the Senate, and take back the House, we cannot abandon our daughters and granddaughters to rulings like this.
You have my word that I will do everything I can to stop further attempts at a national ban that come through the Senate, and that I will continue to push to pass legislation that makes the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land.
But to get all of that done, we need to win this year. The alternative is too dangerous to consider. I’m raising money to build infrastructure in Arizona that can help defeat Kari Lake, Donald Trump, and the MAGA extremists who are pulling this country apart.
And I need your support.

In theory, America helped Iran fund this attack when our leaders [failed to enforce sanctions](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d0ba6809c498475497c8a01d12415f9d&_e=E8d3QI5tPy-DyC64sMS4B0MHyEHzlhsCrBbnj3gq2jRnTXByNrbbiohjE-K1OmzVB_pXohR9J9r-Mr7X6qqIacVooQM_r_XlR9-vYYJpN6xkLfAEqPu-dUFOF4KOd18UIiu5J5Bu5d8uaZNf1oUYImT2bJkn1EpMuxJmPidR-Hstgm2pMosMPzVvVx1gMQGZHnkX6Qf38UZq4_hBx-v3YuwmrYBkyK-eaaJJVsF3RWniReMzJu5kk0EOxdhN791RY0N96p-N2w9BXPes-oifLZKajjQh-MlHM_hyH4uOXCSALBUKOYBfqVp2cc_BoZUs) and essentially gave it a stamp of approval, saying any action just needed to be ["within certain limits.”](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d0ba6809c498475497c8a01d12415f9d&_e=E8d3QI5tPy-DyC64sMS4B8DfGfL1MCTs36Or4Tlett2rIpj7JR1ZTC3SspHH-AtfCMUsrLAZw3CgVp8TX4TdNbzWpunRNaaFcuugSmSSts_Nnx74hmg6RIFFe1pRuTmCe7QHS71YpJ9AIl8oO4JAHnOmysTefUe8JZDffnzmApkukHxLPVuEBCPdueC6dzxExExi4hnMVy_TE9N1kx4-NReAqeEbR7y2n9t6rBpWDKwBXm_ruGYgqJp7Pc5u0g1NEZtPrTSsRRnQBePmrhi1-pwOyZXm5qw3ReqW5TlapzcXOx6SG-MWdxCtt5OuQGKH538EGCVLrx9YzEzv5v9jyQ%3D%3D) This is not the way we defend and protect Israel, folks—and I can’t shake the feeling that this wouldn’t have happened under President Trump’s watch. On this Tax Day, let’s work to cut taxes for middle class families and get rid of the giveaway to billionaires and large corporations |

Peter, Today is Tax Day and while most of us are happy to pay our fair share, we all know the current tax code is **_fundamentally unfair._** We can thank my opponent, Rep. David Schweikert, for being a huge part of that problem. As a member of the powerful House Ways and Means Committee, he has played a lead role in cutting taxes for billionaires and big corporations and raising them on the middle class. If you think that’s a great idea, say a “Tax Day thank you” to David Schweikert. [If you think we need to do the reverse, will you donate $4.15 or $41.50 or $415 to help me work for a tax code that is fair and powers our economic growth?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83092473/467259612/1690568760?refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240415_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDI4YjdhMGUtNmZmYi1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=GZ7CPGOsgslkuhFuNEdpfoEt67GXEXzhEILtrqh6Cso=) David Schweikert was a major force behind pushing the Trump Tax Cuts which was not only the most fiscally irresponsible action in American history, but a massive giveaway to billionaires and large corporations. In fact, they actually cut taxes for **_foreign investors by $40 billion a year._** Schweikert then followed that up by voting to allow the 2021 middle class tax cut to end. This was the most massive tax increase on the middle class in American history – about $3,000 for the average Arizona family. This is not only about fairness. Over the past fifty years, Republicans have pushed the idea that our economy grows from a top-down trickle onto the everyday Americans. They’re wrong. **Our economy grows from the middle-out** – when Americans have more money in their pockets they buy the things that make our economy go and grow. Picture this: We wake up on November 6 and see the headlines that Democrats not only defended our five incredible incumbents in battleground states and won big in Arizona, Michigan, and Maryland, but we also picked up Democratic Senators in Florida and Texas. Here's why each state offers a potential opportunity for us this year. Florida, a traditional battleground state, has an abortion rights measure on the ballot this year, a former Congresswoman running for Senate with roots in the state, and an unpopular Republican incumbent in Rick Scott. Texas is challenging, though we have a great candidate and current Dallas Congressman — and former football player! — running against deeply unpopular Ted Cruz. **_And they both need our help to win!_** How do we get it done? Well, the only way it would be even remotely possible to win all these races in November is if our grassroots team starts organizing TODAY. **That's right. A community organizer and activist who served her neighbors in Pennsylvania’s State House before running for Congress in 2022, Summer became the first Black woman to represent Pennsylvania in Congress.
In response to Wall Street billionaire Jeffrey Yass inserting himself and his money into Summer’s race, funding attack ads trying to defeat her, the legislative director from local group 1HoodPower said:
> _"Pittsburgh was deemed the worst livable city for Black women. Is it any surprise that a billionaire who made his money off of our exploitation is trying to stop us from electing champions who advocate for what our communities need to thrive and be safe?"_
Summer is indeed a progressive champion. She understands that we’re in office not only to pass transformative policies, but also to serve our constituents, helping them navigate everyday challenges like securing federal benefits—and she’s opened a number of neighborhood service centers and mobile offices to do so.

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.

Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

clean_body: whatever you can spare | | | Friend, I wanted to reach out to personally thank you. I have so much to thank you for, so this message is a bit longer than usual. But in case you're short on time, I have to make sure that you see this first: My mid-month deadline is approaching, and we're still pacing dangerously short of my $75,000 goal.= | | = If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins. In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible. I alsoreleased my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability. From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen. I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom. Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve. There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory. Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. Missing my first goal of Q2 would be sending a crystal clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you again for all that you do. I'm so grateful to have you on my team as we head into the second quarter of this critical election year. With love, Kirsten | | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

body:
Israel came under attack from Iran over the weekend. Ukraine is under withering assault from Russia. Taiwan continues to be in China’s crosshairs.
#
This has gone on for far, far too long, Derek.
Israel came under attack from Iran over the weekend. Ukraine is under withering assault from Russia. Taiwan continues to be in China’s crosshairs.
A National Security package passed the Senate on a bipartisan basis - 70-29 - that supports our friends and allies and fulfills our obligation to their defense and to our global efforts at deterrence.
But Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson has FAILED for MONTHS to take ANYTHING approaching a good-faith effort at passing this National Security package.
A majority in the House supports it. We have run more than $700,000 in television ads targeting Republicans nationally and in their home districts to move support for Ukraine. It would pass if it came to a vote.

Now is the time and enough is enough. Stop blocking votes. Start taking action. Listen to Ronald Reagan, stand up for our common values, and do your job, Mike.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: A Declaration of Independents
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=ba9fc55977&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Hello, I hope that you’re doing well. I’m on the way to TED right now to speak about our political system and how it can be improved – it should be a great opportunity. I expect the talk to be made public sometime in May.

When I ran for office, I ran as a Democrat. It seemed practical and, to some extent, natural. But there were significant distortions that accompanied the primaries I participated in – there were certain interest groups and schools of thought that were highly overrepresented.

One person who figured this out even before he ran for office is Greg Orman. “The two parties have spent their time and treasure protecting Americans that we are for more different and divided than we actually are,” writes Greg in his book, “A Declaration of Independents.” I interview Greg on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=3d542caa7d&e=0f227c2ae3) this week.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f55022e8a3&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Greg started a successful business in Kansas and saw that many voters felt underrepresented. He decided to run for the Senate in Kansas in 2014. “I initially looked at running as a Democrat because I was heading against a Republican incumbent. But I soon realized that there was dogma on both sides that I didn’t agree with. I’ve never believed there were only two possible answers to any problem. Many issues are more nuanced than that.”

Greg went around the state and just started talking to voters. He got more and more support with his straightforward, commonsense approach. “Why is it that it’s harder and harder for Americans to get ahead, but it’s also simultaneously more common for people to be using their time unproductively? Something is going wrong here.” Greg believed that the two-party system was a big reason why things were getting worse for Kansans, not better.

Greg went up and up in the polls. He even pulled ahead of the incumbent Senator, which shocked the establishment. It got to the point where the national Republican Party sent John McCain and a parade of national figures to Kansas and spent $17 million to make sure they kept the seat. They defined Greg as a Democratic puppet and attacked him in various ways. He still wound up with 42.5% of the vote in the general election, a stunning level for an Independent candidate. For context, Ross Perot got 19% in 1992.

“I was running against the entire establishment, and the system came to Kansas and did its best to shut me down,” Greg said. Today, he supports independent candidates and continues to make the case. “I back those who are trying to create a new choice in American politics. Almost half of Americans are Independents at this point, and we are being shut out as our future and that of our kids is increasingly jeopardized.”

As you can imagine, Greg is one of the role models for independent candidates in the whole country, and I’m proud to say that he is supportive of our work at Forward. In some ways, the enemy is ideology. “True independence comes not through adherence to a rigid ideology but through putting our country ahead of a political party . . . independence from the party line, from the special interests that control both major political parties through campaign cash, and from extremists who control each party’s primary process – that’s what the country needs to move forward.”

For “A Declaration of Independents” click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=1101569604&e=0f227c2ae3) and my interview with Greg click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9a86ba22e3&e=0f227c2ae3). To see what Forward is doing for candidates around the country of any party, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b8f5051ddb&e=0f227c2ae3). I’ll be speaking at the [Hudson Valley Ideas Fest](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c8abdbac54&e=0f227c2ae3) with Stephen Dubner, Coleman Hughes, Rikki Schlott, Xochitl Gonzalez, Neil Parikh and more on April 27th in Rosendale, New York. If you’re in the area or know someone who is, maybe I’ll see you there!

Andrew Yang**

But I soon realized that there was dogma on both sides that I didn’t agree with. I’ve never believed there were only two possible answers to any problem. Many issues are more nuanced than that.” Greg went around the state and just started talking to voters. He got more and more support with his straightforward, commonsense approach. “Why is it that it’s harder and harder for Americans to get ahead, but it’s also simultaneously more common for people to be using their time unproductively? Something is going wrong here.” Greg believed that the two-party system was a big reason why things were getting worse for Kansans, not better. Greg went up and up in the polls. He even pulled ahead of the incumbent Senator, which shocked the establishment. It got to the point where the national Republican Party sent John McCain and a parade of national figures to Kansas and spent $17 million to make sure they kept the seat. They defined Greg as a Democratic puppet and attacked him in various ways. He still wound up with 42.5% of the vote in the general election, a stunning level for an Independent candidate. For context, Ross Perot got 19% in 1992. “I was running against the entire establishment, and the system came to Kansas and did its best to shut me down,” Greg said. Today, he supports independent candidates and continues to make the case. “I back those who are trying to create a new choice in American politics. Almost half of Americans are Independents at this point, and we are being shut out as our future and that of our kids is increasingly jeopardized.” As you can imagine, Greg is one of the role models for independent candidates in the whole country, and I’m proud to say that he is supportive of our work at Forward. In some ways, the enemy is ideology. “True independence comes not through adherence to a rigid ideology but through putting our country ahead of a political party . . . independence from the party line, from the special interests that control both major political parties through campaign cash, and from extremists who control each party’s primary process – that’s what the country needs to move forward.” For “A Declaration of Independents” click and my interview with Greg click . To see what Forward is doing for candidates around the country of any party, click . I’ll be speaking at the with Stephen Dubner, Coleman Hughes, Rikki Schlott, Xochitl Gonzalez, Neil Parikh and more on April 27th in Rosendale, New York. If you’re in the area or know someone who is, maybe I’ll see you there! | Andrew Yang Co-Chair, Forward Party | | | Want to change how you receive these emails? You can or .

_Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment)._

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83096276/467270214/-973341575?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240415_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkYTM1Mzk3LTc2ZmItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ObQnchFAiwyelIuKp16lc3X6l7s_6OI86_bJYdIDMNg=)

Peter – I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years.

**I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival.**

But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. **I am still an optimist.**

It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years.

**I’m humbly asking:** [_Will you make a donation to my friends at 314 Action and Defeat Republicans ahead of their deadline at the end of the month? They are working to elect climate scientists and climate champions at all levels of government and they can’t do this work without you._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83096277/467270215/-973341575?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240415_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkYTM1Mzk3LTc2ZmItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ObQnchFAiwyelIuKp16lc3X6l7s_6OI86_bJYdIDMNg=)

You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world.

So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect.

**It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more.**

But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry.

**This is the most pivotal election for climate to date.** My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. If these candidates win their tough races, we will secure a climate majority in Congress and in state legislatures across the country.

**Our window to act is closing. So I’m asking you to act:** [_Join me in supporting 314 Action and Defeat Republicans. Let’s elect a historic wave of Democratic scientists who will lead the fight on climate._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83096278/467270216/-973341575?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240415_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkYTM1Mzk3LTc2ZmItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ObQnchFAiwyelIuKp16lc3X6l7s_6OI86_bJYdIDMNg=)

clean_body: Our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). = Peter – I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years. I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival. But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. I’m humbly asking: = You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world. So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect. It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more. But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry. This is the most pivotal election for climate to date. My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. We’re witnessing a historic crisis of greed in this country. A mere 0.1%
of Americans – the billionaire class of Musk, Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg, and
Jamie Dimon – hoards $20,000,000,000,000, or 14% of all the wealth in
America! And it’s not us just who’ve been talking about the likes of Bezos

of us have seen our slice of the American dream shrink. That’s exactly why
we need to tax millionaires and billionaires right now so that they pay
their fair share into Medicare, Social Security, public education, the
fight against climate change, and much much more.

Peter — In 2022, Michelle ran for Congress to be a representative for the working-class families of South Texas. After her community asked her to run again in 2024, without hesitation, she was ready to continue her fight for affordable healthcare, reproductive rights, and good-paying jobs for the community she grew up in. We’re running a grassroots campaign and reaching out to voters across our district in South Texas to flip this seat blue. We refuse to have the families of TX-15 continue to be ignored and counted out yet another term in Congress. South Texas has a voice, and we need it to be heard. Our MAGA extremist opponent Monica De La Cruz is more interested in taking orders from outside interests rather than from the hard-working families of TX-15 she's meant to represent. But Peter, we need help from our community — that's you! We want to hear from you about what matters to you and your loved ones. [Can you take just 30 seconds (we promise!) to fill out a short survey to help us understand your priorities for 2024?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83096590/467271541/707379214?source=SBD_MV_EM_SU_041524_1_1_PrioritiesSurvey&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlM2UxYzBkYi03N2ZiLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9WDtWdOVgNw7xl1l5UDqt_CPAIB0nxt2Lk0o7GtxtBE=&emci=d5e1c0db-77fb-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=e3e1c0db-77fb-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=19309188) | Peter's 2024 Survey Status:

As the daughter of Mexican immigrants, Michelle watched her parents work multiple jobs, live paycheck to paycheck, and open Pulga Los Portales (a flea market) that helped her family connect with small business owners and local working families in South Texas — all on their own during Michelle’s childhood years.
Her mother, Maribel, passed away in 2010 after dealing with health issues ever since Michelle was a child. Michelle would often travel with her mother to Mexico to receive health care — a reality that many families in South Texas face due to the lack of affordable healthcare available here in South Texas. Michelle is ready to honor her mother’s legacy by fighting for affordable healthcare and for working families like her own in South Texas.
In 2024, too much is at stake for the families of TX-15 to continue to get left behind. South Texans travel out of state to receive reproductive health care, because our reproductive rights are _banned_ by MAGA extremists like our opponent. Our current leadership does absolutely nothing about it.
Michelle is ready to serve only the families of South Texas and fight for affordable healthcare, reproductive rights, and good paying jobs because these are the issues that matter most to our community. After her community asked her to run again in 2024, without hesitation, she was ready to continue her fight for affordable healthcare, reproductive rights, and good-paying jobs for the community she grew up in. We’re running a grassroots campaign and reaching out to voters across our district in South Texas to flip this seat blue. We refuse to have the families of TX-15 continue to be ignored and counted out yet another term in Congress. South Texas has a voice, and we need it to be heard. Our MAGA extremist opponent Monica De La Cruz is more interested in taking orders from outside interests rather than from the hard-working families of TX-15 she's meant to represent. But Peter, we need help from our community — that's you! We want to hear from you about what matters to you and your loved ones. | Peter's 2024 Survey Status: INCOMPLETE | | As the daughter of Mexican immigrants, Michelle watched her parents work multiple jobs, live paycheck to paycheck, and open Pulga Los Portales (a flea market) that helped her family connect with small business owners and local working families in South Texas — all on their own during Michelle’s childhood years. Her mother, Maribel, passed away in 2010 after dealing with health issues ever since Michelle was a child. Michelle would often travel with her mother to Mexico to receive health care — a reality that many families in South Texas face due to the lack of affordable healthcare available here in South Texas. Michelle is ready to honor her mother’s legacy by fighting for affordable healthcare and for working families like her own in South Texas. In 2024, too much is at stake for the families of TX-15 to continue to get left behind. South Texans travel out of state to receive reproductive health care, because our reproductive rights are banned by MAGA extremists like our opponent. Our current leadership does absolutely nothing about it. Michelle is ready to serve only the families of South Texas and fight for affordable healthcare, reproductive rights, and good paying jobs because these are the issues that matter most to our community. | | Today, millions of hard-working Americans are finishing up filing their taxes. It's a day that puts into stark relief how our country is still living a tale of two tax codes: **one where working families pay taxes out of each paycheck, and one that lets the ultra-wealthy get away without paying their fair share.** A teacher, firefighter, or delivery driver in Philomath, Oregon doesn't get to call up an army of high-priced lawyers and accountants any time they don't feel like paying their taxes. Working families pay taxes out of each paycheck, but billionaires don't have to play by the same rules. And the _really_ infuriating part? **It's all perfectly legal** – because Republicans and special interest groups have spent decades rewriting the tax code to stack the decks in favor of billionaires and steadfastly blocking any effort at reform. **Enough is enough.** This Tax Day I'm renewing my calls for a Billionaires Income Tax to finally ensure that the ultra-wealthy start paying their fair share. If billionaires paid their fair share, we could improve our roads, child care, schools, you name it. We could make much-needed investments in critical lifelines that Americans rely on like Medicare and Social Security. **We could strengthen the American dream and make our country a better place to live, work, and raise a family for**** _everyone_****, not just those at the very top.** You know as well as I do: the majority of Americans are sick and tired of paying what they owe while our country's wealthiest and well-connected keep cheating the system. We recognize both the urgent need and opportunity before us. I'm proud to play my part in this fight to level the playing field for working families and create an economy that works for everyone by leading the fight for my Billionaires Income Tax. This fight won't be easy in the face of so much entrenched opposition from special interests, but having voices like yours behind our movement gets us one step closer to prevailing. clean_body: | | | | Today, millions of hard-working Americans are finishing up filing their taxes. It's a day that puts into stark relief how our country is still living a tale of two tax codes: one where working families pay taxes out of each paycheck, and one that lets the ultra-wealthy get away without paying their fair share. A teacher, firefighter, or delivery driver in Philomath, Oregon doesn't get to call up an army of high-priced lawyers and accountants any time they don't feel like paying their taxes. Working families pay taxes out of each paycheck, but billionaires don't have to play by the same rules. And the really infuriating part? It's all perfectly legal – because Republicans and special interest groups have spent decades rewriting the tax code to stack the decks in favor of billionaires and steadfastly blocking any effort at reform. Enough is enough. This Tax Day I'm renewing my calls for a Billionaires Income Tax to finally ensure that the ultra-wealthy start paying their fair share. If billionaires paid their fair share, we could improve our roads, child care, schools, you name it. We could make much-needed investments in critical lifelines that Americans rely on like Medicare and Social Security. We could strengthen the American dream and make our country a better place to live, work, and raise a family for everyone, not just those at the very top. You know as well as I do: the majority of Americans are sick and tired of paying what they owe while our country's wealthiest and well-connected keep cheating the system. We recognize both the urgent need and opportunity before us. I'm proud to play my part in this fight to level the playing field for working families and create an economy that works for everyone by leading the fight for my Billionaires Income Tax. This fight won't be easy in the face of so much entrenched opposition from special interests, but having voices like yours behind our movement gets us one step closer to prevailing. Dear Peter,
My campaign first requested Secret Service protection in May of 2023 with a 63-page declaration showing the many threats that have been made against me.
Despite filing five additional requests, _all have been refused_.
We are currently awaiting responses to our pending requests from both the Secret Service and the White House.
This marks the first time in 55 years that a presidential candidate’s request for protection has been denied.
It's unprecedented in history for a presidential candidate not to receive Secret Service coverage from the administration.
Think about that for a moment—it's a significant deviation from the norm.
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_service_4_15_24_r2_nd1&n=5)
---
Polls, a key factor in determining eligibility for Secret Service protection, show strong support for my campaign.
According to a New York Times/Siena Poll, I'm at 24% in battleground states. An NBC poll suggests 34% of Americans could see themselves voting for me, indicating a base of 50 million Americans rallying behind our vision.
Historically, presidential candidates received Secret Service protection well in advance of the election, regardless of political affiliation—Obama by the Bush Administration, Trump by Obama, and Biden by Trump.
The decision not to grant me Secret Service protection appears to be a strategic move to impact our campaign's momentum and resources. _However, this only strengthens our resolve to push forward and ensure our voice is heard._
The challenges we face, including certain decisions from Secretary Mayorkas and the current administration, highlight the need for vigilance and resilience in our campaign.
[Can I count on your continued support today?](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_service_4_15_24_r2_nd1&n=6)

[CONTRIBUTE $24](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=24&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_service_4_15_24_r2_nd1&n=9)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=100&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_service_4_15_24_r2_nd1&n=10)
[CONTRIBUTE $240](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=240&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_service_4_15_24_r2_nd1&n=11)
[CONTRIBUTE OTHER AMOUNT](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_service_4_15_24_r2_nd1&n=12)
I want to be clear: my respect for the Secret Service is immense. The issues we face stem from decisions made far above their jurisdiction.
Judicial Watch has recently uncovered a substantial number of documents from DHS related to my request for Secret Service protection, yet over 100 pages were redacted.
_What are they trying to hide?_
So, here’s what I want to say to the political establishment and those maneuvering in secrecy: _I’m not going anywhere!_
Our movement is growing stronger. Our coalition is building. I’m more steadfast than ever about winning in November.
Thank you for your faithful support!

| I just talked to my team, and it looks like our fundraising has been slowing down this month.

## Israel Weighs Response to Iran Attack
Israeli officials say they're [united in wanting to respond](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuO2zAQAL-G6tbgU7QLFWnUXdqUwppaiZujSIPanOF8feDUV08xg_n1sXwgF677Tzxokq0t9EWV6754MAGsX8ywThuRJTfQZKJx1umo3ZCnmydNCV1MRtMWggvRR9TBXMd0S3caeLLaeu1NsM5GM142nWLEsK2YrpsJRnlNK0vrl9-Nq2Tayqt9Ub-kdgxlyiKPU7kfys7KzpIpcylvpuz8aIXTS9mZq1CvKNwqFmVnH25udFfI1P-2HfjsSAVqEziJPrnu8MQOT5YM3LHC_Y8AimD6hIwnSIM7wUECmFLrK9e9vDVDn9bHk0vhc4zK6_1A_t8yyPfb_gUAAP__CC1w_A) to Saturday's attack by Iran, even though the U.S. has asked them to hold back and says it won't offer aid in any counterattack. American warships helped Israel shoot down hundreds of Iranian drones and missiles launched in retaliation for Israel destroying Iran's embassy in Syria. Virtually none of the missiles got through and caused damage. [See video here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71utDAQAJ_G7kBe_3-Fi6-hu7QpkbHXsJHBJ7AO5e2jS512RhppPh_zI1KlY_2IO4Ze2owvPOhYZz2AGaSegedQECUqjgEcKKmEE4pvwfpFGYHeaUhaOxBJYbTWIGoDOUVOQQqphQYjlXRgxyKSc9GUHJMvYIBpgZl6O8evRkffsNTv9sJzTG3nNWy9Py-m_jM5MTnd9z0uS3o7JqcD7-sN21nzsFPOFQeMVx-s9yDUP8_PkJ831UqXdUyLdY9Uf8P978-fAAAA__-teFMn) President Biden called an emergency meeting of the G7 nations, the world's major democracies, who urged restraint. Biden pledged "ironclad" support for Israel if it's attacked, but [not if it attacks Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOszAQBOCnMZ2Rd43j_IWLv6HLtVeiBdZhT46NwAmXtz9x9TVfM9KMNJ-34UaSJN8_6MGhxjLwi7Pk-9BpcBq7AZo5RGZk23AADxat8cY2SxgnS9a5CMY4jG6M_67TTGD8aC4MjhoJaLAzHTi06OHSRjN5Ty7ONF0jOFCd4Vlq2dqvIrkuHNO7vHhrp_JoUlhqXXdl_yvsFfbHcbT0LWU_U4X92a2wNydwMsrMWWeulN-0PLVslLXsG3HSz10fJVe9P9e1bLXZwrwekpLsF686c3-QpN_V-vcJPwEAAP__5Ild3w) back. Israeli President Isaac Herzog said the country wasn't "seeking war," but the attack had "to be met accordingly."
## Tax Day: Where Does the Money Go?
Today is April 15, the official deadline for Americans to settle their federal taxes with Uncle Sam. Last year, U.S. citizens paid the government [nearly $4 trillion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAYhJ_GbFjwAwYPDF2ypWtHi8CPTYUhIiRu3r5y566n052-7-u6XF3KqayfbkfbY13whSWVdZGUKwpy4STYiAgoCFquuQDBNBNks_PkDQrm5skAsFloo-YozE2Cnp0KhiQLDCSTXIEAzacxMq-1UzE4byJXfJAMQ-q1jd81lb5hzO_6wjb6upNst97vj0F8DHAZ4HIcx9g3vLnsise9FnyfvQEu_tkalk6f9EEjBmwu0_XcKfsZd_dD24n1RCoEU3oC0my4Hynn9Jj0INm6u5T_Xvv_En4DAAD__x4RXrM) in income and payroll taxes. [This new infographic chart](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL_GbFhwQHAHhi7Z0rWjdTaHfRUxkSF2-_dVOnd-T3p6n7fxhpx5Wz7wTqGlMtJBG2_LaKV2EuyoRQyJCMgICtprA0Z5ZcQaUIEDP0yTw7c04ETmAmawE8xRo_cgOIACq6x2YMDrS5_U7D26FHEekna6s4oit7L3X4W3tlLKP-WgvZ_LXeSwtvaonXnv4NrB9TzP_uD6xDzjgxtmru0lvtBKO8lYqMqykXzKKht-y1hyxl0upYOr2EN8nJwz14vvrFruyPmv0_7f_g0AAP__mspahw) shows where each dollar of tax revenue goes once it reaches the federal budget. Health and Medicare spending account for 28% and Social Security is 22%, making up about half of all federal spending. National defense accounts for 13%, and interest payments on America's outstanding debt are 11%. The rest covers veterans services, transportation, commerce, and other government functions. About two-thirds of taxpayers get a refund back. For those who still have more to pay, here are tips on [how to file for an extension](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u9CAQAJ8Gd7aWBZtzQfF9itxd2pQWZxZ7Iwwnw_29fZSrU08xmvk6z2fHkdP66XayNeSZ7pQ4rbNuZd-inmXjbSBCUg1ZaaRCBQZUs1mgkx8B_OBpUZdx0EaZcHFkAo7eON-wRUANWvao0MihC7AY4_rg3XIKspdCA3mu-ei-M6e6UYivfKejW_LeRLvVei1C_RM4CZzcZUn0KN2af7HA6f-tcKJSBE47p1ultrpnG945LT0rpcI5CZxKzcdLqIm9UB8SRjhJhX1zWH99cIxcBiM0rLvj-DbXv0f8BAAA__9JSV-t).
## Scheffler Takes Home Masters' Victory
Scottie Scheffler, the world's No. 1 golfer, [won his second Masters'](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAUQNGvwRsWPLCxB4YubOna0SLwsKkwREBj5e-rdO58lqv7ddtuNqaY9097ou6hbPjEHPO-SconCnLjg9cBEVAMqLniAgRTTAyHtlZYtCvO1jnpQC1wvzsXmOPSrXxeh6iBgWSSTyBA8XkMzCllp-CtWwKfOJEMfeyljt8l5n5gSK_yxDq6cg5JH70_GhEfBAwBc13XiO2R30jA7CUFAqb1Ul8EzEbARE_AiHWVki_wNld6j0ibOzCEhJVeMTfa0JXs6Wlbx9poiNkmWstP9nRehqr944opxTYrItl-2pj-evr_e34DAAD__8_PZ5A) Tournament by four strokes Sunday, finishing at 11 under par to break out of a crowded field on the back nine. It's only the second major Scheffler's won, both of them at the Masters, but the 27-year-old has been ranked No. 1 for 80 weeks during his career. He was the favorite going into the tournament. Scheffler [shot a 68 Sunday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L3OpCAAheGrwQ7DnzJTWGxjN9tuaRAOyiyCATJm7n7j1l__Js_J-fNaXibEkLbf5sDUfF7wQQppWxTlAxVq4Z2bPCAgO0xccykk00x2-6SZeoxqsKuWdn06P4zyabk2D-GtU6vswiSYUEzxQUih-dh7ZrU2g3fGPjwfOFEMLrRc-ncOqe3w8Zs_KL3NRxenvbWzEvmLiJmI-bqu3q61nrm0ehdEzFuOnog54apEzLdGD1MbSqURxqGs2RRHr5ASCq02txZAq93hfbyr07SAZEFXbGiVVticHN0KkOjb2L9oNCTa9gLQL0y5nRg-IGLuyuTOK8QY6qiJYtthQvw_vf385L8AAAD__1vyeOg), scoring three birdies heading into the turn, and then another three birdies over the last six holes. He earned $3.6 million for the victory.

## Why Do Bad Things Happen To God's People?
---
Many people ask the question: "why do **bad things** happen to **good people**?" That question is _invalid though_ because the Bible says there is none righteous. Which means there are no good people for bad things to happen to... A better question but much tougher question is this: **WHY DO BAD THINGS HAPPEN TO GOD'S PEOPLE?** So many times in life we find ourselves following God yet simultaneously walking through hell. How does that work and why? This last Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=9110346.3968.1.d60c1ee74ebeb1c635e01826b14d049c), we addressed this difficult question that we all face. Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

Peter,

Our coalition continues to grow.

Today, I’m excited to announce a pair of key endorsements.

First, I received Trailblazer status and the endorsement from the **Congressional Leadership Fund** , the political action committee of Republican House Leadership that provides direct financial support to key Republican candidates with the ability to help grow the House Majority.

Second, I also received the endorsement of **Maggie’s List** , the country's leading political action committee specifically focused on electing conservative women to federal public office.

Both of these groups recognized that **1)** our race is key to our House majority, and **2)** we have what it takes to win.

This remains one of the closest and most competitive races on the ballot in 2024. With only a 3-seat margin, NM-02 could very well decide whether we continue to hold the House Majority or cede it to the radical Left.

I am grateful for the growing list of endorsements we have garnered, which is a testament to the importance of this race not only to New Mexico, but the nation.

Yours in the fight,

Yvette Herrell

Today, I’m excited to announce a pair of key endorsements. First, I received Trailblazer status and the endorsement from the Congressional Leadership Fund , the political action committee of Republican House Leadership that provides direct financial support to key Republican candidates with the ability to help grow the House Majority. Second, I also received the endorsement of Maggie’s List , the country's leading political action committee specifically focused on electing conservative women to federal public office. Both of these groups recognized that 1) our race is key to our House majority, and 2) we have what it takes to win. This remains one of the closest and most competitive races on the ballot in 2024. With only a 3-seat margin, NM-02 could very well decide whether we continue to hold the House Majority or cede it to the radical Left. I am grateful for the growing list of endorsements we have garnered, which is a testament to the importance of this race not only to New Mexico, but the nation.
